audits.r2: Progress towards ideal: personnel 20%, patient rights 15%, equipment 40%, emergency service 60%, clinical guidelines 55%, risk prevention 70%, medical records 60%.

audits.t: Temperature--the forgotten vital sign.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Temperature recorded in 13.4%.

audits.t: Women with learning disability and uptake of screening: audit of screening uptake before and after one to one counselling.
audits.tp: Cancer screening uptake in learning disability
audits.st: Average national and local screening uptake
audits.f: Breast screening uptake 37 of 48 (77%); cervical screening 26 of 160 (16%).
audits.c: One-to-one counselling by a learning disability team nurse to encourage screening
audits.r2: Nine more women had smear tests, bringing cervical screening uptake to 22%.

audits.t: A clinical audit of the quality of care of hypertension in general practice.
audits.st: Ministry of Health Jamaica hypertension standards of care
audits.f: Nutritional advice 33%; smoking/alcohol history 40%; physical activity 30%; fundoscopy 11%; foot examination 30%; yearly electrolytes 28%.
audits.c: Physicians sensitised to preliminary audit results.
audits.r2: Nutritional advice 74%; smoking/alcohol 65%; physical activity 47%; fundoscopy 54%; foot exam 58%; electrolytes 62%.

audits.t: Enhancing quality of heart failure care in managed Medicare and Medicaid in North Carolina: results of the North Carolina Achieving Cardiac Excellence (NC ACE) Project.
audits.st: Evidence-based heart failure guidelines (LV function assessment, ACE inhibitors, beta-blockers)
audits.f: LV function assessed in 88.2%.
audits.c: Guideline summary dissemination, performance audit with feedback, patient-specific chart reminders and patient activation mailings.

audits.t: Morbidity associated with asthma and audit of asthma treatment in out-patient clinics.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Only 43% received inhaler therapy; no patient received steroids; only 8.5% ever had PEFR recorded.

audits.t: A multi-district audit of the management of HIV infection in pregnant women and the prevention of mother-to-child transmission: Yorkshire HIV pregnancy audit.
audits.st: British HIV Association guidelines for management of HIV infection in pregnancy
audits.f: 20/22 mothers received therapy as recommended; 16/22 (73%) elective caesarean; 12/22 (55%) definitely received intravenous zidovudine in delivery; 19/22 infants received appropriate antiretrovirals for four to six weeks.

audits.t: Description of a system designed to assist primary dental care clinicians in decision-making with regard to specialist periodontal referrals and report of two clinical audits using the system.
audits.st: British Society of Periodontology guidelines; BPE recording
audits.f: BPE recorded in 139 (62%); 11 (8%) identified as Complexity 3 and referred.
audits.c: Training by a periodontal specialist and a computer-prompted screening and risk-classification system.
audits.r2: BPE recorded in 179 (80%); 14 identified as Complexity 3 and referred.

audits.t: Tube feeding in mechanically ventilated critically ill patients: a prospective clinical audit.
audits.st: Early enteral nutrition protocol
audits.f: Only 39% of prescribed EN delivered; 8 (22%) tolerated EN within 48 h and met minimum requirements.

audits.t: Colonoscopy in a private hospital: continuous quality improvement in practice.
audits.st: Results reported in world literature
audits.f: Figures not reported in abstract.

audits.t: A criteria-based audit of the management of severe pre-eclampsia in Kampala, Uganda.
audits.st: Criteria developed by an expert panel
audits.f: Most standards rarely achieved.
audits.c: Guidelines, extra supplies purchased, streamlined labour ward procedures and more staff
audits.r2: Significant improvements in diagnosis, monitoring and treatment.

audits.t: Assessing the primary nurse role in the wound healing process.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Primary nurses involved in every step of wound care; figures not reported.

audits.t: An audit of symptom triggered chlordiazepoxide treatment of alcohol withdrawal on a medical admissions unit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Patients discharged before resolution of withdrawal symptoms.
audits.r2: Symptom duration significantly reduced; length of stay reduced (not significant).

audits.t: An audit of anticoagulation practice among UK cardiothoracic consultant surgeons following valve replacement/repair.
audits.st: ACC/AHA 1998 and American College of Chest Physicians 2001 anticoagulation guidelines after valve replacement
audits.f: All use lifelong warfarin after mechanical valves; only 16% (16/97) follow guidelines for bioprosthetic AVR and 28% (24/86) for bioprosthetic MVR.

audits.t: NSF for CHD: 3 years of 12-month follow-up audit after cardiac rehabilitation.
audits.st: CHD National Service Framework Standard 12 Milestone 3: at one year, regular physical activity (30 minutes five times a week), not smoking and target BMI
audits.f: Questionnaires returned by 903 (80%); of responders 74% exercising regularly, 95% not smoking and 79% met the BMI target.

audits.t: Alveolar bone grafting: achieving the organisational standards determined by CSAG, a baseline audit at the Birmingham Children's Hospital.
audits.tp: Cleft lip and palate care standards
audits.st: CSAG organisational standards for cleft care (national CSAG success rate 58%; published series about 95%)
audits.f: 81% alveolar bone graft success (68 of 82 with sufficient data); grafting after age 11 in 28% (6/21) BCH patients and 46% (22/47) referred patients.

audits.t: Breech presentation: an audit project as means of pursuing clinical excellence.
audits.tp: Breech presentation and external cephalic version
audits.st: Delivery suite protocol and national guidelines on breech presentation
audits.f: Low ECV success rate and deficient documentation of written consent for ECV; other care satisfactory.
audits.c: Results presented to a multidisciplinary meeting and disseminated to stakeholders
audits.r2: Significant improvement in documented consent for ECV; good breech detection, optimal ECV offer rate and good neonatal outcome.

audits.t: Ask the children--auditing children's services with PALS standards.
audits.st: PALS national standards and National Service Framework for Children (DH 2003)
audits.f: Parents reported good information before and during consultation but wanted more written information; very few had heard of PALS and around half did not know whom to approach with concerns.

audits.t: A population audit of first clinic attendance with suspected epilepsy.
audits.tp: First seizure and suspected epilepsy assessment
audits.st: British Paediatric Neurology Association (BPNA) audit tool for children with suspected epilepsy
audits.f: Seizure sequence recorded in 91%; early development and school performance documented in 41%; 24% had no documented physical and neurological examination; referral to epilepsy nurse or support group in 11%.

audits.t: Audit of the laboratory diagnosis of Lyme disease in Scotland.
audits.st: American and European standards for Western blot interpretation
audits.f: Retrospective re-scoring: 39 (33%) of 116 negative or equivocal samples became weak positive or stronger; 31 (80%) of these were clinically suggestive of early Lyme disease.
audits.r2: Significant increase in equivocal results and fewer negatives compared with the same period a year earlier.

audits.t: Clinical audit of patients with cervical cancer in Slovenia--data analysis for the year 2003.
audits.tp: Invasive cervical cancer screening history review
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 92 (61.7%) had seen a gynaecologist in the previous five years; 67.6% had Pap II three to six months before diagnosis.

audits.t: Audit of negative assessments in a breast-screening programme in women who later develop breast cancer-implications for survival.
audits.tp: Breast screening interval cancers and false negatives
audits.st: Current breast screening assessment guidelines
audits.f: Of 21,657 negative assessments, 193 women later had cancer at the assessed site; 17 deaths, 15 in women with unsatisfactory assessments; five-year breast cancer survival 93%.

audits.t: External audit of clinical practice and medical decision making in a new Asian oncology center: results and implications for both developing and developed nations.
audits.st: Previously reported audit instrument for clinical documentation/quality assurance and decision making
audits.f: Documentation/QA adequate 74.4%, decision making 88.3%, overall 80.2%; 52.0% received suboptimal management.

audits.t: An audit of urgent referrals by the Procurator Fiscal to the Tayside Forensic Psychiatric Service.
audits.tp: Court liaison and forensic psychiatric referrals
audits.st: Home Office guidelines (1990) on diversion of mentally disordered offenders
audits.f: Urgent referral rate increased over time, mainly patients already known to psychiatric services, 37% of whom were detained and admitted.

audits.t: Urinary catheterization in care homes for older people: self-reported questionnaire audit of catheter management by care home staff.
audits.st: NICE and Association of Continence Care urinary catheter care standards
audits.f: 750/1438 (52%) staff responded; 83% of nursing and 40% of other care staff had formal catheter training; at least 10% did not wash hands before handling a catheter; bladder washouts used routinely by 50%; urine specimens taken from bag tap by 29% of nursing and 54% of other staff.

audits.t: Warfarin induction at 5 mg daily is safe with a low risk of anticoagulant overdose: results of an audit of patients with deep vein thrombosis commencing warfarin.
audits.st: Low-dose warfarin protocol (5 mg daily, INR days 4 and 6)
audits.f: Therapeutic INR in 21% on day 4 and 52% on day 6; INR above 4.0 in one on day 4 and nine on day 6.

audits.t: Comparing outcomes of carotid endarterectomy with international benchmarks: audit from an Italian vascular surgery department.
audits.st: International benchmarks for CEA stroke and death rates
audits.f: Symptomatic stroke 0.7% at all time points, death 0%; asymptomatic stroke 0.6% perioperatively and 0.3% at 180 days.

audits.t: Hearing half the message? A re-audit of the care of patients with acute asthma by emergency ambulance crews in London.
audits.st: Service treatment protocols aligned with British Thoracic Society acute asthma guidelines
audits.f: Some under-recognition and under-treatment of severe asthma; poor documentation of on-scene condition; 58% of A&E-diagnosed asthma patients given nebulised salbutamol by crew.
audits.c: Protocols widened in line with BTS guidelines, results disseminated and training for all operational staff
audits.r2: 75% of A&E-diagnosed asthma patients given nebulised salbutamol; 43 asthma patients untreated; protocol adherence high.

audits.t: Catheter specimens of urine: an audit of practice.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Redesigning acute mental health services: an audit into the quality of inpatient care before and after service redesign in Grampian.
audits.st: Scottish Framework for Mental Health (1997); local quality indicators (admissions, bed occupancy, incidents, locked-door days, observation levels, sickness, bank hours)
audits.f: Baseline indicator rates; figures not given in the abstract.
audits.c: Closure of one of five acute admission wards, remaining four wards increased from 25 to 28 beds, and increased community mental health team staffing.
audits.r2: Rates of the indicators had not increased, so quality of inpatient care was judged at least as good as before.

audits.t: Audit on routine HIV testing in patients attending genitourinary medicine clinics.
audits.tp: HIV testing uptake in STI patients
audits.st: Sexual Health Strategy 2001: all patients attending GU medicine clinics for a sexual health screen should be offered an HIV test
audits.f: Patients accepted HIV testing when offered routinely (figures not reported).
audits.c: Routine offer of HIV antibody testing to clinic attenders

audits.t: Audit of the outcome of pregnancy in diabetic women in Soweto, South Africa, 1992 - 2002.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Perinatal mortality 3.7% versus 15.6% in control group; caesarean rates over 60%; major malformations 1.5%.

audits.t: Delayed detection of cleft palate: an audit of newborn examination.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Day of detection recorded in 92%; detection delayed beyond day 1 in 28% overall (37% isolated cleft palate, 23% syndromic).

audits.t: National audit of continence care for older people: results of a pilot study*.
audits.tp: Continence assessment and care in older inpatients
audits.st: Good Practice in Continence Services and the National Service Framework milestone for integrated continence services
audits.f: 85% of hospitals had no written continence policy; access to integrated continence services was inadequate; deficiencies in assessment, examination and investigation.

audits.t: [Local guidelines and quality of antibiotic treatment in urinary tract infections: a clinical audit in two departments of a university hospital].
audits.tp: Antibiotic prescribing for urinary tract infection
audits.st: Local guidelines for antibiotic therapy in UTI (drug, dose and duration)
audits.f: Correct (conforming) prescriptions 30.4%; justified prescriptions 41.8%.
audits.c: Dissemination of local UTI antibiotic guidelines.

audits.t: Evaluation of surgical and anaesthesia response times for crash caesarean sections--an audit of a Singapore hospital.
audits.st: RCOG Organisational Standards: decision-to-delivery within 30 minutes for urgent caesarean section
audits.f: Mean decision-to-delivery 7.7 min (SD 3.0); 100% within 17 minutes; mean decision-to-anaesthesia 3.5 min.

audits.t: Compliance of renal transplant recipients with advice about sun protection measures: completing the audit cycle.
audits.tp: Skin cancer surveillance and education in organ transplant recipients
audits.st: Advice on sun protection measures for renal transplant recipients
audits.f: Poor compliance with sun protection advice despite education.
audits.r2: Significant increase in the proportion of patients taking appropriate precautions (figures not reported).

audits.t: Audit of the use of antimicrobial prophylaxis in nasal surgery at a specialist Australian hospital.
audits.st: Australian and international evidence-based guidelines for surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis
audits.f: 306 (72.86%) received antimicrobials; only 24 (5.71%) received them immediately before surgery and at no other time.

audits.t: Prospective audit of treatment of paediatric febrile neutropenia in Australasia.
audits.st: International guidelines (no national guidelines)
audits.f: 18 first-line antibiotic regimens; initial regimen changed in 61%; 30% had positive blood cultures.

audits.t: Shared maternity care: all care--not enough responsibility? An audit of patient care communications pre- and post- a multi-faceted intervention.
audits.st: Key communications between hospital and GP in shared care
audits.f: Figures not reported; 150 hospital records per hospital and 20 GP files.
audits.c: Multifaceted communication initiatives, including making one person responsible for a communication outcome.
audits.r2: Significant improvements only where one person was made responsible; other initiatives did not improve.

audits.t: An audit of contact tracing for cases of chlamydia in the Australian Capital Territory.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Of 437 nominated contacts, 272 (62.2%) contacted, 125 (28.6%) tested and 51 (11.7%) positive.

audits.t: The development of a city-wide epilepsy register.
audits.st: Epilepsy quality marker in the new GP contract (regular review)
audits.f: 41% seen by a GP in the past year; 19% had regular review; 49% saw no doctor about epilepsy in the past year; 11% diagnostic uncertainty; 29.2% in documented remission.
audits.c: Computerised template with suggestions produced for every patient; review left to each GP

audits.t: Implementation and clinical audit of alcohol detoxification guidelines.
audits.st: Hospital alcohol detoxification guidelines (CIWA-Ar, Wernicke's prophylaxis) and Royal College of Physicians 2001 recommendations
audits.f: High levels of compliance with the guidelines; figures not reported.

audits.t: Ultrasound based measurement of 'carotid stenosis >70%': an audit of UK practice.
audits.st: ECST or NASCET measurement methods for diagnosing carotid stenosis over 70%
audits.f: 26% of units used NASCET, 31% ECST and 43% did not know; similar proportions of each group used a peak systolic velocity threshold over 230 cm/s.

audits.t: Malignant spinal cord compression: a retrospective audit of clinical practice at a UK regional cancer centre.
audits.st: Builds on Clinical Resource and Audit Group (CRAG) work; standard not specified
audits.f: Poor pain assessment, poor ambulatory status on admission and no clear mobilisation or rehabilitation plans for most patients

audits.t: Five year audit of peripartum blood glucose control in type 1 diabetic patients.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Mean blood glucose 5.2 mmol/l 7 h before and 4.7 mmol/l 1 h before delivery; four women had mild symptomatic hypoglycaemia before delivery and two after.

audits.t: An audit of advice on fitness to drive during accident and emergency department attendance.
audits.st: DVLA 'At a glance guide to the current medical standards of fitness to drive'
audits.f: Of 22 patients needing driving restrictions, only one had documented advice about driving.

audits.t: An audit of thrombophilia screens: results from the National Pathology Alliance benchmarking review.
audits.st: British Committee for Standards in Haematology (BCSH) guidelines on investigation of heritable thrombophilia
audits.f: 47 of 57 trusts performed a routine thrombophilia screen; 10 complied with the guidelines and 37 did not.

audits.t: An audit of diabetes control, dietary management and quality of life in adults with type 1 diabetes mellitus, and a comparison with nondiabetic subjects.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Mean HbA1c 8.5% in women and 8.6% in men; most had suboptimal control.

audits.t: Clinical notes for informal carers in palliative care: recommendations from a random patient file audit.
audits.tp: Carer needs documentation in palliative care
audits.st: Completeness of assessment data recording for informal carers (no external standard stated)
audits.f: 100 files (69.9%) had identifiable informal carers; patient data complete but carer data severely lacking; primary carer need was finance and welfare advice (n=64).

audits.t: The need for quality management in primary health care in Cyprus: results from a medical audit for patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
audits.st: Internationally accepted treatment targets for HbA1c, blood pressure and lipids
audits.f: Only 10.5% had an HbA1c recorded, 77.4% of these 8% or more; LDL measured in 29.4%, 20.7% under 100 mg/dL.

audits.t: Adjuvant systemic therapies in patients with colorectal cancer: an audit on clinical practice in Italy.
audits.st: 1990 NIH Consensus Conference recommendations
audits.f: Stage II colon cancer made up a substantial share of adjuvant chemotherapy (139 N-); 37 (38.5%) of 96 stage II-III rectal cancer patients did not receive radiotherapy.

audits.t: An audit demonstrating a reduction in MRSA infection in a specialised vascular unit resulting from a change in infection control protocol.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Hospital-acquired MRSA colonisation 10.6%.
audits.c: Isolation policy changed to segregate patients by risk of MRSA acquisition and isolate all prosthetic vascular reconstructions; antibiotic policy altered

audits.t: A national audit of gonorrhoea management.
audits.st: Auditable outcome measures in the National Guideline for the Management of Gonorrhoea in Adults and evidence-based outcome standards (Low et al.)
audits.f: Auditable outcome measures and outcome standards were broadly being met.

audits.t: MRI directed multidisciplinary team preoperative treatment strategy: the way to eliminate positive circumferential margins?
audits.st: National guideline CRM+ve rate below 20%
audits.f: Overall CRM+ve rate 12.5% (32/256) in nonpalliative patients; 26% (16/62) with surgery alone without MRI-based MDT discussion vs 1% (1/116) with MDT discussion
audits.c: Policy of mandatory preoperative MRI-based MDT discussion
audits.r2: Overall CRM+ve rate 7% (5/70); surgery-alone CRM+ve rate 3% (1/37)

audits.t: Radiotherapy treatment verification in the UK: an audit of practice in 2004.
audits.st: Current practice in treatment verification (no external standard stated)
audits.f: Response 48% (30/62); 97% (29/30) had site-specific written verification protocols; 67% (20/30) audited set-up errors; 83% (24/29) with portal imaging used image analysis software; 53% used off-line correction strategies.

audits.t: An audit of red cell and blood product use after the institution of thromboelastometry in a cardiac intensive care unit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Red cells used in 60%, FFP in 17% and platelets in 16% of patients.
audits.c: Introduction of near-patient thromboelastometry (ROTEM) in January 2002.
audits.r2: Red cells used in 53%, FFP in 12% and platelets in 11% (P < 0.05).

audits.t: An audit of imaging test utilization for the management of lymphoma in an oncology hospital: implications for resource planning?
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Routine follow-up 21% of assessments (142/686); follow-up CT with no indication 8% (25/296) of CT assessments.

audits.t: What do you get when you fall in love?: Warehouse Youth Health Centre chlamydia audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Overall chlamydia positivity 8.8% (17/194); 179 (92.3%) of those tested were female.

audits.t: Audit of the use of benzathine penicillin, post-treatment syphilis serology and partner notification of patients with early infectious syphilis.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 31 received benzathine penicillin first line; 17 (42.5%) failed to attend any post-treatment serology and only 13 (32.5%) attended full one-year follow-up.

audits.t: Group B streptococcal testing during pregnancy: survey of postpartum women and audit of current prenatal screening practices.
audits.tp: Group B streptococcus screening in pregnancy
audits.st: Nova Scotia guidelines for GBS screening (culture at 35-37 weeks or risk factor approach)
audits.f: 24.5% screened by vaginal-rectal culture at 35-37 weeks; 75.5% assessed by risk factor approach.

audits.t: The application of a simplified system of criterions for audit to improve paediatric cardiologic and paediatric cardiac surgical care: evidence from a regional approach in Hungary.
audits.st: Five audit criteria on timely diagnosis, access to treatment and outcome (international standards)
audits.f: 28 infant deaths (0.1% of newborns), one malformation recognised post mortem; postoperative mortality 9.2%.
audits.r2: 21 infant deaths (0.09%), all diagnosed before death; postoperative mortality 4.6%.

audits.t: An audit of the management of melanoma patients at Glasgow Royal Infirmary 1998-2003.
audits.st: SIGN guidelines for melanoma management
audits.f: Re-excision and sentinel node biopsy guidance closely followed; only 30% of referrals marked urgent; median time to first appointment 20 days (1998) to 52 days (2001); surgical margins recorded in 13%.

audits.t: Quality and completeness of histopathology reports of rectal cancer resections. Results of an audit in Brittany.
audits.st: French 1998 guidelines for pathology reports of rectal cancer resections (at least 8 lymph nodes examined)
audits.f: Number of nodes examined in 204 (84%); at least 8 nodes in 53.4%; circumferential margin recorded in 27%; pTNM staging in 67%.

audits.t: Audit of hypertension in general practice.
audits.st: Structure, process and outcome indicators with targets (BP 140/90 or less, 130/80 with diabetes or renal insufficiency)
audits.f: Targets met for only four indicators (weight 89%, BP monitoring 85.8%, follow-up within 6 months 87.9%, mean diastolic BP 73.9%); 743 (59%) reached target BP.

audits.t: Antibiotic prophylaxis for external ventricular drains in neurosurgical patients: an audit of compliance with a clinical management protocol.
audits.tp: Antibiotic prophylaxis for external ventricular drains
audits.st: Restrictive EVD antibiotic protocol (e.g. intravenous cephalothin 1 g 6-hourly for 24 hours)
audits.f: Prophylactic antibiotics in 5/12 (42%); positive CSF Gram stain 3/12 (25%); CSF not analysed in 35/72 samples (49%).
audits.c: Introduction of an EVD management protocol with restrictive antibiotic prophylaxis, daily sterile CSF sampling and drain removal after five days.
audits.r2: Prophylactic antibiotics in 12/15 (80%); positive Gram stain 0/15 (0%); positive CSF cultures fell (17 vs 5, p = 0.0009).

audits.t: Clinical governance in practice: closing the loop with integrated audit systems.
audits.tp: Outcome audit in a secure rehabilitation unit
audits.st: Standardised psychometric outcome measures (no standard stated)
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Failure of a quality improvement process to increase nutrition delivery to intensive care patients.
audits.st: Predicted daily energy requirement for patients staying over 3 days
audits.f: Nutrition started 2.2 +/- 1.3 days after admission; 100% of requirement reached by 4.8 +/- 3.3 days; nutrition on 82.3% of patient-days; daily average 71.7% of energy requirement; interrupted on 30% of patient-days.
audits.c: Clinical Practice Improvement model used to analyse reasons for inadequate feeding and change practice, targeting interruptions for extubation and upper GI intolerance.
audits.r2: Interruptions for these reasons significantly reduced but no significant overall improvement in time to nutritional goals or energy received.

audits.t: How we do it: coblation tonsillectomy complication rates from a single ENT department compared with the National Prospective Tonsillectomy Audit.
audits.st: National Prospective Tonsillectomy Audit rates
audits.f: Haemorrhage and return to theatre rates for coblation tonsillectomy similar to national rates for cold steel and ties.

audits.t: Nursing documentation audit--the effect of a VIPS implementation programme in Denmark.
audits.st: VIPS model for nursing documentation (Cat-ch-Ing instrument)
audits.f: Baseline figures not reported.
audits.c: Structured VIPS implementation programme with training of all nursing staff.
audits.r2: Documentation significantly improved; keywords used correctly after the second year.

audits.t: A five-year audit of anal cancer in Wales.
audits.st: NICE recommendation that all patients are referred to a multidisciplinary anal cancer team
audits.f: About 26 cases a year; 80% referred for oncology opinion; 50% had curative chemoradiotherapy; stoma rate 35%; five-year survival 45%.

audits.t: Are general practitioners equipped to detect child overweight/obesity? Survey and audit.
audits.st: 2003 NHMRC guidelines recommending bi-annual measurement of all children
audits.f: 44% of GPs regularly weighed children, 38% measured height, only one calculated BMI.

audits.t: The effect of a primary care intervention on management of patients with diabetes and hypertension: a pre-post intervention chart audit.
audits.st: Process-of-care and outcome targets for diabetes and hypertension
audits.f: Diabetes BP target 20.4%, retinopathy screening 33.8%; hypertension systolic target 40.6%.
audits.c: Collaborative practice teams with nurse practitioner, alternative physician funding and an information system.
audits.r2: Diabetes BP target 28.5%, retinopathy screening 41.9%, nephropathy 71.3%; hypertension systolic target 55.3%, diastolic 85.3%.

audits.t: Potential for organ donation in the United Kingdom: audit of intensive care records.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 2740 potential heartbeating donors and 1244 actual donors; 41% of families of potential donors denied consent; no record of next of kin being approached in 15%.

audits.t: UK National Audit of Early Syphilis Management. Clinics audit: screening for and management of early syphilis.
audits.st: UK national guidelines for early syphilis screening and management
audits.f: 3 clinics (2%) did not routinely screen new patients and 28 (21%) did not screen rebook patients with a new partner; 19 (14%) did not routinely use recommended regimens; 7 (5%) used inferior PPG treatment.

audits.t: An audit of the indications for the reporting of blood films: results from the National Pathology Benchmarking Study.
audits.st: International Consensus Group for Haematology Review guidelines for preparing blood films
audits.f: Wide variation in criteria used for preparing blood films compared with the consensus guidelines.

audits.t: Evaluation of a learning collaborative to improve the delivery of preventive services by pediatric practices.
audits.tp: Preventive care delivery in primary care
audits.st: National standards for preventive services in 2- and 4-year-olds
audits.f: Mean Preventive Service Score 4.0 for 2-year-olds and 3.8 for 4-year-olds.
audits.c: Learning collaborative: QI workshop with audit feedback, rapid cycles of change, brief audits and monthly conference calls.

audits.t: Blood pressure control in haemodialysis patients: an audit.
audits.st: Five audit criteria for blood pressure control, including predialysis BP control
audits.f: 40 patients (38%) had controlled predialysis BP.

audits.t: Optimizing training opportunities for otolaryngology senior house officers: an audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 30% of theatre sessions attended; case participation 27%.
audits.c: Simple timetable (rota) changes to maximise SHO theatre attendance.

audits.t: [Implementation of clinical guidelines in general practice. The effect of journal audit and continuing education for the treatment of cardiovascular risk factors in patients with and without type 2 diabetes].
audits.tp: Cardiovascular risk assessment in primary care
audits.st: Clinical guidelines for prevention of ischaemic heart disease in hypertension, dyslipidaemia and type 2 diabetes
audits.f: Approximately 15-40% of patients achieved treatment goals.
audits.c: GP education through workshops and an international meeting, plus journal audit.
audits.r2: Some improvement; gap between recommended and actual treatment remained.

audits.t: Data-driven quality improvement in the Emergency Department at a level one trauma and tertiary care hospital.
audits.st: CQI metrics: turnaround time, left AMA or without being seen, complaints
audits.f: Mean quarterly turnaround 183 min; complaints 2.1 per 1000; AMA/LWOBS 2.7%.
audits.c: CQI programme with monthly data analysis, data-driven process change and staff education.

audits.t: Management of allergic rhinitis in UK primary care: baseline audit.
audits.st: Consensus statement on the treatment of allergic rhinitis (four standards: symptom identification, diagnostic information, examination and investigations, treatment)
audits.f: All criteria met: Standard 1 14% (n=26), Standard 2 23% (n=43), Standard 3 0% (n=0), Standard 4 0.6% (n=1).

audits.t: An audit of referral practice for patients with impacted palatal canines and the impact of referral guidelines.
audits.st: Regular attenders with unerupted palatal canines referred by age 12, with wait no longer than 20 weeks
audits.f: 98% seen within 20 weeks; 16.5% referred by age 12; 82% had retained deciduous canines.
audits.c: Management algorithm distributed to all local dentists
audits.r2: 98% seen within 20 weeks; 27% referred by age 12 (p = 0.09); 76% retained deciduous canines (p = 0.29).

audits.t: [Clinical audit as method of quality improvement of healthcare in patients with diabetes, stroke and in cesarean section].
audits.st: Audit criteria questionnaires; AKAZ accreditation standards
audits.f: Diabetes retinal and foot screening poorly recorded; preoperative stay for caesarean 4 days in hospital A versus 0.4 days in hospital B.

audits.t: Abdominal radiograph requesting in the setting of acute abdominal pain: temporal trends and appropriateness of requesting.
audits.st: Royal College of Radiologists guidelines for abdominal radiograph requests
audits.f: RCR guidelines followed in 73 of 225 (32%); positive findings 76.7% when guidelines followed vs 8.9% when not.

audits.t: An audit of the quality of endometrial cancer care in a specialised unit.
audits.st: Completeness of staging information compared with previously published Scottish audit results
audits.f: FIGO stage available in 100%; chest X-ray 85%; peritoneal cytology 93%; pelvic lymphadenectomy 28%; all significantly better than the Scottish audit.

audits.t: UK National Audit of Early Syphilis Management. Case notes audit: diagnosis and treatment.
audits.st: UK National Guidelines for early syphilis diagnosis and treatment
audits.f: EIA used to diagnose 695 (89%); dark ground microscopy in only 80 (29%) primary cases; HIV testing uptake 77%; 14 (5%) PPG treatments below the recommended 750 mg dose; recommended doxycycline regimen used in 104 (53%) oral treatments.

audits.t: UK National Audit of Early Syphilis Management. Case-notes audit: contact tracing, information giving, follow-up and outcomes.
audits.st: UK National Guidelines: at least 60% of traceable contacts seen; follow-up at 1, 2, 3, 6 and 12 months
audits.f: Contact tracing provided for 683/781 (87%); 511 of 997 traceable contacts (51%) seen against a 60% standard; only 16 (2%) had follow-up at the recommended intervals.

audits.t: An audit of analgesia after day case gynaecological laparoscopic surgery.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Management of early pregnancy loss--a complete audit cycle.
audits.st: RCOG Green-top Guideline 25
audits.f: Not reported in abstract (given in Table I).
audits.c: Results distributed to units and formal instruction in the RCOG guideline

audits.t: Review of analgesia use in the intensive care unit after heart surgery.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Paracetamol given to 70 (96%) but prescribed 6-hourly in 24 (33%); no analgesia before chest drain removal in 23%.

audits.t: Audit of phlebotomy turnaround time in a private hospital setting.
audits.st: Existing phlebotomy service standards (targets not stated)
audits.f: 1,867 of 2,118 test requests (88.1%) were phlebotomy requests; mean response 7.4 ± 1.5 min, arrival 5.6 ± 1.6 min, completion 10.4 ± 2.4 min; overall TAT 23.4 ± 4.1 min per request.

audits.t: A clinical audit of a nurse colposcopist. Colposcopy: cytology: histology correlation.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 82% (82/100) histology: cytology: colposcopy correlation in the third phase of training.

audits.t: Opportunistic chlamydia testing: improving nursing practice through self-audit and reflection.
audits.st: Opportunistic chlamydia testing of clients (target not stated)
audits.f: Zero opportunistic chlamydia testing in 50 consecutive client visits.
audits.c: Nurse reflected on the results of the first audit (self-audit and reflection).
audits.r2: Increase in testing and in education about chlamydia (figures not given).

audits.t: Practice Audit in Gastroenterology (PAGE) program: a novel approach to continuing professional development.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 173 participants completed PAGE-Endo (6168 procedures) and 111 PAGE-Colo (4776); reported findings lower than expected, e.g. oesophagitis E 29.9% vs R 14.8%, gastric ulcer E 17.0% vs R 4.7%.

audits.t: The quality of dental radiography in the Czech Republic--results of a TLD and film postal audit.
audits.st: Checked parameters: field size, exposure reproducibility, entrance surface air-kerma, film processing and image quality
audits.f: Only about 30% of audits were satisfactory for all checked parameters.

audits.t: An audit of follow-up chest radiography after coronary artery bypass graft.
audits.tp: Routine chest radiography after cardiac surgery
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Chest radiography in 645 patients; abnormality in 13 (2%), all pleural effusions, confirmed clinically in 7 (53.9%); only 1 patient needed readmission and intervention.

audits.t: An audit of corneal abrasion management following the introduction of local guidelines in an accident and emergency department.
audits.st: Local corneal abrasion guidelines developed by A&E and ophthalmology staff
audits.f: Contact lens enquiry 35.3%; local anaesthetic drops given out; visual acuity documentation lower (figure not given).
audits.c: Introduction of local guidelines on corneal abrasion management with some training.
audits.r2: Visual acuity documented in 93%; contact lens enquiry 71.9%; no local anaesthetic drops given; appropriate discharges up 40%, inappropriate eye clinic referrals down 75%, abrasion advice up 101%.

audits.t: Promoting physicians' self-assessment and quality improvement: the ABIM diabetes practice improvement module.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 14 of 16 physicians completed the module; all but 1 found the medical record audit gave important practice information.
audits.c: Quality improvement education specialist gave on-site and distance consultation.

audits.t: Pain in an emergency department: an audit.
audits.tp: Time to analgesia in the emergency department
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 563 (78%) had pain on arrival; pain rated by nurses in 23% and physicians in 11%; 27% received analgesics during stay; 395 of 480 (82%) unrelieved before discharge.

audits.t: Audit of severe maternal morbidity in Uganda--implications for quality of obstetric care.
audits.tp: Maternal death and severe morbidity review
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Of 685 women with severe morbidity, 229 were near-miss cases; substandard hospital care in about half.

audits.t: Audit of hepatitis C antibody requests made by a genito-urinary department.
audits.st: National guidelines for hepatitis C antibody testing
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Managing sexually transmitted infections in community sexual health clinics: an audit of a community service.
audits.tp: Sexually transmitted infection management in primary care
audits.st: Proposed national outcome standards for chlamydia treatment and partner notification
audits.f: 84% of chlamydia clients treated with a median delay of 14 days; partner notification documented in 88% of chlamydia treatments; 0.45 contacts per case treated; standards exceeded.

audits.t: [Conceiving and implementing an ISO 9001:2000 quality management system: quality improvement and efficiency increase over 3 years at the Dept. of Ophthalmology, Sultan Qaboos University in Oman].
audits.f: Monthly documented non-conformities fell: inpatients -50%, outpatients -20%, operating theatre -100%, teaching -10%.
audits.c: ISO 9001:2000 quality management system: standardised documentation, responsibility clusters, procedural changes and continuous audits.

audits.t: Prediction of in-hospital mortality and length of stay using an early warning scoring system: clinical audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Baseline documentation of physiological parameters recorded (848 patients across both periods); figures not given in abstract.
audits.c: Introduction of a standardised early warning scoring system (SEWS).
audits.r2: Documentation of physiological parameters improved (P<0.001-0.005) except oxygen saturation (P=0.069); inpatient mortality decreased (P=0.046).

audits.t: Nurse-led management of carpal tunnel syndrome: an audit of outcomes and impact on waiting times.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Unacceptable waiting times for carpal tunnel syndrome before the service (figures not given in abstract).
audits.c: Rapid-access nurse practitioner-led single practitioner pathway from first clinic through surgery to discharge.
audits.r2: Waiting times improved considerably while standard and quality of care were maintained (figures not given in abstract).

audits.t: Audit of catheter-associated UTI using silver alloy-coated Foley catheters.
audits.st: Aim to reduce CAUTI rate by 20%
audits.f: CAUTI rates captured with Trust standard catheters (figures not given in abstract).
audits.c: Introduction of silver alloy-coated Foley catheters.
audits.r2: Aim of reducing CAUTI rate by 20% met and exceeded; CAUTI risk rate and device rate fell.

audits.t: An audit of the quality and content of periodontal referrals and the effect of implementing referral criteria.
audits.st: Periodontal referral guidelines/criteria
audits.f: Use of Basic Periodontal Examination (BPE) score in referrals 17%; medical history mentioned in 31-34% of letters.
audits.c: Referral guidelines implemented (2000/2001), then referral criteria redefined and circulated via Primary Care Trusts (2004/2005).
audits.r2: BPE score use 57%; medical history still mentioned in only 31-34% of letters; clinical details had increased in 2000/2001 with a tendency to decrease in 2004/2005.

audits.t: Does a higher 'quality points' score mean better care in stroke? An audit of general practice medical records.
audits.tp: Secondary prevention after stroke or TIA
audits.st: Royal College of Physicians stroke guidelines for primary care; QOF stroke quality points
audits.f: Practice A scored 93.5% (29/31) of QOF stroke points; practice B 73.4% (22.75/31) but better RCP adherence: assessed in secondary care 96% vs 79% (P=0.001); seen same day 64% vs 44%; rehabilitation 56% vs 37%.

audits.t: Implementation of a data management program in a pediatric cancer unit in a low income country.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Of 652 leukaemia patients, 150 (23%) unregistered and 65 (10%) missing records; in 437 charts protocol information incomplete in 30% and cause of death inaccurate in 18%; other data 99% accurate and 93% to 100% complete.

audits.t: [Quality of mental health services: a self audit in the South Verona mental health service].
audits.st: Quality assurance questionnaire, with a senior manager's evaluation as benchmark
audits.f: Wide variation in key workers' answers; senior manager at the 60th percentile; risk management, personnel development and CQI needed prompt action.
audits.c: Changes to service practice with monitoring meetings over one year.

audits.t: Audit of nurse-led-training for epipen in a District General Hospital.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Previous community study found most families prescribed adrenaline auto-injectors could not use them properly.
audits.c: New prescribing protocol for doctors and a nurse-led allergy clinic with one nurse training all patients.
audits.r2: Most patients reported training, had written instructions, demonstrated competence on a dummy and would appropriately call an ambulance; significantly better than before.

audits.t: Prescribing oxygen therapy. An audit of oxygen prescribing practices on medical wards at North Shore Hospital, Auckland, New Zealand.
audits.st: Oxygen should be prescribed in the medication chart
audits.f: Only 8% of patients receiving oxygen had it prescribed; 75% of prescriptions were inadequate.

audits.t: Guidelines audit may overcome disparities in health care: experience of an Italian region.
audits.st: Italian Society of Nephrology guidelines on osteodystrophy and anaemia (target: more than 70% of patients within range)
audits.f: In 2000 only 27% of centres had more than 70% of patients at the phosphate target; median 42% of patients had haemoglobin 11 to 12 g/dL, only 2 centres had more than 70% above target.
audits.c: Open regional reporting of audit results to centres.
audits.r2: Relative improvement in osteodystrophy results (figures not given).

audits.t: Funnel plots, performance variation and the Myocardial Infarction National Audit Project 2003-2004.
audits.st: National Service Framework standards for door-to-needle and call-to-needle times and aspirin, beta-blocker and statin use
audits.f: 163 hospitals met door-to-needle standards; 116 fell outside call-to-needle standards (28 below lower control limit); 16 failed aspirin standard (24 below lower control limit); 49 outside beta-blocker standard (30 below lower control limit); statin use comparable

audits.t: Audit of the management of patients admitted with community acquired pneumonia.
audits.st: British Thoracic Society CAP guidelines
audits.f: Severity assessment at presentation per guidelines in 56 (34.1%); appropriate antibiotics within 8 hours in 123 (75.0%).

audits.t: How we do it: an audit of Action on ENT baseline standards in otolaryngology departments in England, UK.
audits.st: Action on ENT baseline clinical and administrative standards (23 standards)
audits.f: Only 8% of 97 departments met all 23 standards; microsuction 99%, outpatient endoscopy 97%, activity monitoring 98%; poor compliance for common waiting lists (51%), patient feedback facilities (56%) and treatment plan in notes (46%).

audits.t: National breast cancer audit: overview of invasive breast cancer management.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Breast-conserving surgery stable at 60%; margins involved in 5% with a further 9% under 1 mm; radiotherapy after breast-conserving surgery 86%; tamoxifen in 83% of ER-positive cases; chemotherapy in 78% of ER-negative node-positive postmenopausal patients.

audits.t: Effective role redesign: an audit of outcomes following the introduction of a new nurse-led service.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Screen performed in 433; chlamydia-positive 41 (9.5%) vs background 8.5%; HIV test uptake 71.2% (311/433); average wait to appointment 3 days vs background 2-3 weeks.

audits.t: Improved surgeon performance in clinical trials: an analysis of quality assurance audits from the American College of Surgeons Oncology Group.
audits.st: Regulatory requirements and patient case review in clinical trials (acceptable vs unacceptable)
audits.f: Major regulatory deficiencies: IRB documentation 31% and informed consent 31% at start (249 audits in total 2001 to 2004).
audits.r2: Major deficiencies fell to 20% for IRB documentation (p = 0.002) and 9% for informed consent.

audits.t: Steady improvement of infection control services in six community hospitals in Makkah following annual audits during Hajj for four consecutive years.
audits.st: Standardised infection control checklist items
audits.f: Average score across 11 infection control items 43% (range 20-67%); lacked committees, units, education, surveillance and staff.
audits.c: Confidential feedback of audit results to hospitals within four weeks; annual repeat audits.

audits.t: Candidaemia in a large teaching hospital: a clinical audit.
audits.st: British Society of Medical Mycology and IDSA candidaemia audit standards (e.g. central venous catheter removal within 48 h)
audits.f: CVC removed within 48 h in 79% (37/47); identification and susceptibility tests 94.7%; antifungal started within 24 h in 84%; appropriate initial therapy 95% (61/64); at least 2 weeks' treatment 81%; transfer guidance on duration only 45%.

audits.t: Audit system on quality of breast cancer diagnosis and treatment (QT): results from the survey on screen-detected lesions in Italy, 2004.
audits.st: Recommendations on screen-detected breast lesion diagnosis and treatment (waiting times, frozen section, specimen X-ray, pre-operative diagnosis)
audits.f: Generally good quality with an improving trend; sentinel node technique used in almost 70% of screen-detected invasive cancers.

audits.t: Rapid assessment methods used for health-equity audit: diabetes mellitus among frail British care-home residents.
audits.st: National standards for diabetes care; Department of Health health-equity audit guidance
audits.f: Diabetes register under-represented known diabetes (3.5% vs 11.5%); inappropriately high glucose monitoring and secondary care involvement; little co-ordinated eye screening; staff needed diabetes training.

audits.t: Preoperative cardiac drug administration in general surgical patients: A completed audit.
audits.st: All regular cardiac medication should be given preoperatively even when nil by mouth
audits.f: 42% of patients had one or more cardiac drugs omitted.
audits.c: Information sheet and brief verbal reinforcement to nursing staff and junior doctors.
audits.r2: Omissions reduced to 20% (p=0.023); p=0.0029 when omissions on medical instruction excluded.

audits.t: Transfusion audit of fresh-frozen plasma in southern Taiwan.
audits.st: Transfusion guidelines for FFP
audits.f: 65.2% of FFP requests inappropriate.
audits.c: Five education sessions on transfusion guidelines, then computerised transfusion guidelines with periodic audits by a consultant haematologist.
audits.r2: Inappropriate requests fell to 30%; FFP transfusions fell by 74.6%. Education alone gave a 5.2% fall in inappropriate use and computerised guidelines a further 30%.

audits.t: HIV testing in Scotland. Are we meeting the standard? BASHH Scotland national audit 2004.
audits.tp: HIV testing uptake in STI patients
audits.st: Draft Scottish Sexual Health Strategy 2003: HIV test offered to all GUM attendees not known to be HIV positive presenting with a new STI; reasons for non-uptake recorded
audits.f: Practice highly variable; overall Scottish GU clinics failed to meet the strategy standard.

audits.t: Risk management considerations and the pregnancy handheld record. An audit of the return rate of the pregnancy handheld record.
audits.st: Return of pregnancy handheld record at admission for labour and birth
audits.f: Return rate 82% in the first audit period; 1096 of 1256 returned overall (85%).
audits.r2: Return rate 88.5% (6.6% increase over the four audits).

audits.t: Survey of early discharge schemes from the 2003 UK National COPD Audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 103 of 233 units (44%) had early discharge schemes; admission prevention in the emergency department 5%; 30% of patients could be put into early discharge schemes.

audits.t: Healthcare-associated infection in pediatric patients on extracorporeal life support: The role of multidisciplinary surveillance.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Sepsis rate 29.3 episodes per 1000 ECMO days before policy changes.
audits.c: Monthly multidisciplinary surveillance meetings; re-education, electively preprimed ECMO circuits, and preference for neck rather than chest cannulation in cardiac patients.
audits.r2: Sepsis fell to 20.1 per 1000 ECMO days; neonatal respiratory 28.0 to 6.6 and paediatric respiratory 42.4 to 16.9 per 1000 ECMO days.

audits.t: Diabetes retinopathy screening: audit of equity in participation and selected outcomes in South East London.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: An estimated 46% of residents with known diabetes (9750/21,104) were offered screening; 88.9% of those invited attended.

audits.t: Management of older patients presenting after a fall--an accident and emergency department audit.
audits.tp: Falls risk screening and multifactorial assessment
audits.st: Assessment and correction of fall risk factors (no specific guideline stated)
audits.f: Previous falls and drug or alcohol history recorded in under 20%; postural blood pressure 2%; cognitive assessment under 30%; no referrals to geriatric medicine, physiotherapy or occupational therapy.

audits.t: Auditing palliative cancer chemotherapy.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Audit of prescribing practices of topical corticosteroids in outpatient dermatology clinics in north Palestine.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 616 of 2458 medications were topical corticosteroids; information on strength, duration and quantity was inadequate in most prescriptions, while frequency, route and area of application were adequate.

audits.t: Audit-based education to reduce suboptimal management of cholesterol in primary care: a before and after study.
audits.st: Cholesterol target in secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease
audits.f: Mean cholesterol 4.75 mmol/l before the programme.
audits.c: Primary Care Data Quality programme: audit-based educational intervention.

audits.t: Departmental audit of tonsillectomy haemorrhage rates: pitfalls in interpretation.
audits.st: not reported

audits.t: An Auckland regional audit of the nurse-led rheumatic fever secondary prophylaxis programme.
audits.st: WHO-recommended secondary prophylaxis
audits.f: Compliance ranged from 79.9% to 100% across community nursing offices.

audits.t: Peripheral lymph node biopsies in children under 14 years at Christchurch Hospital 1982-88: an audit.
audits.st: not reported

audits.f: Coagulation variables measured at any point in the episode in only 65.9% of FFP-transfused patients; FFP usually given in paired doses.

audits.t: An audit improves the quality of water within the dental unit water lines of three separate facilities of a United Kingdom NHS Trust.
audits.st: American Dental Association guideline on DUWL water quality and EU potable water standard
audits.f: The two units using disinfection regimes met the ADA guideline and EU potable water standard; the unit that only flushed failed both.
audits.c: All three facilities standardised DUWL disinfection using Bio 2000; one unit then moved to continuous super-oxidised water (Sterilox).
audits.r2: Colony counts from all samples stayed well below the EU recommended level; the Sterilox unit achieved and maintained zero readings.

audits.t: Scandinavian Quality Register for Thyroid and Parathyroid Surgery: audit of surgery for primary hyperparathyroidism.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Localisation in 65%; bilateral exploration 66.8%; cure rate 91.9%; postoperative hypocalcaemia 11.4%.

audits.t: A pilot audit of weight loss in upper gastrointestinal oncology outpatients.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Only 40% weighed at clinic visit; 65% self-reported weight loss; only 35% had received dietary advice and 68% of the rest would have liked some.

audits.t: The impact of clinical audit on antibiotic prescribing in general dental practice.
audits.st: Contemporary antibiotic prescribing guidelines and agreed standards
audits.f: 43% of prescriptions error-free in dose, frequency or duration; 29.2% justified.
audits.c: Education on prescribing guidelines, presentation of previous errors and agreed standards

audits.t: An audit of the UK national cancer referral guidelines for suspected oral mucosal malignancy.
audits.tp: Head and neck cancer two-week-wait pathway
audits.st: UK National Cancer Referral Guidelines for suspected oral mucosal malignancy (2000)
audits.f: 487 of 901 referrals classed as potentially malignant; in a subgroup of 241, 18 had malignant (8) or dysplastic (10) lesions; guidelines missed 15% of malignant or dysplastic lesions.

audits.t: Audit of radiation dose during balloon mitral valvuloplasty procedure.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Mean DAP 19.16 Gy cm2 on one machine and 21.19 Gy cm2 on the other.
audits.c: Copper filters and optimised exposure parameters on one machine.
audits.r2: Mean DAP 9.36 Gy cm2 after optimisation.

audits.t: Audit of a diabetes clinic at Tawam hospital, United Arab Emirates, 2004-2005.
audits.st: ICSI type 2 diabetes guidelines and CDC targets (dilated eye exam 75%, foot examination 75%, diet and exercise advice 60%)
audits.f: All had blood pressure checked and aspirin; all but one had HbA1c and lipids; 75% referred for eye exam but only 47% attended; foot examination documented in about a quarter; diet and exercise advice in 40%; just under half had HbA1c below 7%.

audits.t: Utilisation of intravenous immunoglobulin in New Zealand: a clinical audit.
audits.st: AHMAC and Auckland DHB IVIG guidelines
audits.f: 80.6% of diagnoses were AHMAC category 1 and 71.5% were approved diagnoses in ADHB guidelines; compliance varied significantly between DHBs.

audits.t: Medical audit on asthma in an emergency department.
audits.st: Four indicators: severity evaluation, diagnostic tests, treatment and discharge plan
audits.f: Respiratory rate recorded in 27%, heart rate 50%, peak flow 20%; oxygen saturation 93%; no treatment in 12%; systemic steroids in 80% of treated; 17% discharged with no change to usual treatment.

audits.t: Data feedback for quality improvement of stroke care: CAPTURE Stroke experience.
audits.st: Stroke quality indicators (DVT prophylaxis, dysphagia screening, antithrombotics, warfarin for AF, lipid screening, smoking counselling)
audits.f: Baseline chart audit of quality indicators (figures not given).
audits.c: Feedback of baseline audit results to 7 of 13 hospitals; 6 had chart audit only.
audits.r2: Difference in mean change, feedback vs no feedback: lipid screening 19.93 (90% CI 2.99 to 36.86); DVT prophylaxis 8.46; smoking counselling 17.47; warfarin for AF 44.73 (not significant).

audits.t: Selective neonatal BCG vaccination - a re-audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: A nurse-/pharmacy-led capecitabine clinic for colorectal cancer: results of a prospective audit and retrospective survey of patient experiences.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 79% completed at least 3 cycles (mean 3.5); dose reduced in 15 (29%); at least one delay in 17 (30%).

audits.t: Postal dose audits for radiotherapy centers in Latin America and the Caribbean: trends in 1969-2003.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: About 5,200 photon beams in over 1,300 centres checked; 36% in Latin America and the Caribbean, with results improving over the years.
audits.c: Follow-up programme for centres with poor results.

audits.t: Acute asthma in a children's emergency room: a clinical audit and management guideline proposal.
audits.st: Asthma management guidelines
audits.f: Triggers, current medication and severity not documented in 73.3%, 93.3% and 96.7%; discharge medication not given in 70.0% and clinic follow-up not arranged in 93.3%.

audits.t: An audit of the laboratory service provided to the Health Service Executive Orthodontic Department, St James Hospital, Dublin.
audits.st: Gold standards based on authors' ideal requirements and published guidelines
audits.f: 20% of laboratory work arrived late; 65% met all gold standards; 10% of appliances unsatisfactory; 20% needed adjustment for more than 30 seconds before fit.

audits.t: An audit of medical record-keeping in maxillofacial surgery at the University College Hospital, Ibadan using the CRABEL Scoring system.
audits.st: CRABEL score
audits.f: Mean total CRABEL score 61.6%; subsequent entries 66.5%, initial entry 65.3%, consent 57.8%, discharge summary 29%.

audits.t: Improved use of thromboprophylaxis for deep vein thrombosis following an educational intervention.
audits.st: Evidence-based VTE prophylaxis guidelines
audits.f: 47% received any prophylaxis; 43% received appropriate prophylaxis.
audits.c: Regular education, a decision support tool and regular audit and feedback to residents.
audits.r2: Any prophylaxis 86% at 12 months, maintained at 18 months; appropriate prophylaxis 68% at 12 months and 85% at 18 months.

audits.t: An educational intervention, involving feedback of routinely collected computer data, to improve cardiovascular disease management in UK primary care.
audits.tp: Cardiovascular risk assessment in primary care
audits.st: Evidence-based audit criteria for cardiovascular disease, e.g. cholesterol management in ischaemic heart disease
audits.f: Cholesterol recording 47.6%; mean cholesterol 5.18 mmol/L; statin prescribing 46%; recorded IHD prevalence 3.8%.
audits.c: Educational feedback of routinely collected computer data with peer-led learning, inter-practice comparisons and lists of patients needing intervention.
audits.r2: After three iterations: cholesterol recording 89.0%; mean cholesterol 4.67 mmol/L; statin prescribing 68% (via 57%); recorded IHD prevalence 4.0%.

audits.t: Quality improvement activities associated with organisational capacity in general practice.
audits.tp: Health equity in chronic disease management
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 82 of 247 GPs (33%) from 57 of 97 practices (59%) took part; 37 (65%) recognised the area most needing improvement; 25 (46%) developed an action plan; 22 (39%) implemented their chosen activity.
audits.c: Feedback report on capacity for chronic disease care followed by practice-chosen clinical audit activity.

audits.t: Measuring the "fifth vital sign" in cataract surgery patients--is it necessary?
audits.st: Hospital pain assessment policy; compliance target 85%
audits.f: Compliance 83%.
audits.c: Staff education and changes to the critical pathway.

audits.t: An audit of medication administration: a glimpse into school health offices.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Wide range of errors and discrepancies in transcription, physician orders, timing, documentation and storage.

audits.t: [Cancer screening by primary care physicians: a chart audit].
audits.st: Documentation of family cancer history and past screening dates and results
audits.f: Family history documented in half; faecal occult blood test mentioned in 51.2% (dated 40.2%); complete mammogram information 27.9%; complete smear information 25.9%.

audits.t: Audit of radiation dose to patients during coronary angiography.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Mean DAP 55.86 Gy cm2 before optimisation.
audits.c: Copper spectral filters and review of operator work practices.
audits.r2: Mean DAP 27.71 Gy cm2 after optimisation.

audits.t: Effectiveness of a continuous quality improvement program on colonoscopy practice.
audits.st: Colonoscopy completion rate of 90% or more
audits.f: Crude completion 84.6% (range 80.4% to 94%); four endoscopists below 90%; polyp detection 34% (range 14% to 42%).
audits.c: Changes to sedation practice, more sessions for lowest performers and other organisational changes, over 6-monthly audit cycles for 4 years.
audits.r2: Crude completion rose to 93.1%; all endoscopists reached 90% or more completion and polyp detection over 20%.

audits.t: Audit of prescribing patterns in Saudi primary health care: What lessons can be learned?
audits.tp: Prescription quality and WHO prescribing indicators
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Antihistamines 25%, paracetamol 20.3%, antibiotics 14.7% of prescriptions; antibiotics given to 26% of URTI patients.

audits.t: Documentation of medication management by graduate nurses in patient progress notes: a way forward for patient safety.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Assessment focused on biomedical cues; little on communication; no record of patient medication education; evaluation of outcomes poorly documented.

audits.t: National Breast Cancer Audit: ductal carcinoma in situ management in Australia and New Zealand.
audits.st: National Breast Cancer Centre DCIS recommendations (2003)
audits.f: Close adherence for diagnostic biopsy, breast-conserving surgery and clear margins; 33% with close margins had no radiotherapy; axillary procedures in 23%; 81% not prescribed tamoxifen.

audits.t: An audit of aspects of informed consent and pain relief in general surgical units of korle bu teaching hospital.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 24 did not know their diagnosis; 36 not told of operation beforehand; 87 did not know possible complications; significant pain on day 1 in 24 at rest and 46 on movement.

audits.t: Estimation of blood loss during Caesarean section: an audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 215 units cross-matched; 9.5% transfused intraoperatively and 5.5% postoperatively; cross-match to transfusion ratio 9.7.

audits.t: A national audit of paediatric service provision in otolaryngology in England and Wales.
audits.st: Department of Health and Royal Colleges of Surgeons and Anaesthetists standards for paediatric surgical services
audits.f: Named paediatric ENT consultant 54.7%; designated clinical lead for children's surgery 56.6%; only 30% met theatre facility requirements; acute pain service in only 26%; 50% of small DGHs had appropriate anaesthetic supervision.

audits.t: [A clinical audit on the use of medications for pressure sores, after the implementation of guidelines].
audits.st: Local pressure sore guidelines
audits.f: 20% of treatments inappropriate (287 sores); grey area 7%.
audits.c: Results returned and discussed with wards after each stage (after guideline implementation).
audits.r2: 12.8% inappropriate (326 sores) (OR 1.79); grey area rose to 13.5%.

audits.t: An audit of cervical cytology in HIV-positive women.
audits.st: NHSCSP guidelines: annual cervical cytology in HIV-positive women
audits.f: 126 (68.1%) had a cytology history, 50 (27%) never had cytology and 9 (4.9%) had inadequate details.

audits.t: Audit of syphilis treatment, follow-up and contact-tracing rates.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Treatment rate 100%; 90% offered testing for other STIs (positivity 24%); HIV testing rate 85%.

audits.t: Completing the audit cycle: comparison of cardiac risk factor management in patients with intermittent claudication in two time periods.
audits.tp: Cardiovascular risk factor management in peripheral arterial disease
audits.st: Secondary prevention standards for cardiac risk factors
audits.f: 104 patients assessed in the previously published audit (results not given in abstract).
audits.r2: 30% (n=91) did not have a diagnosis of intermittent claudication confirmed; cardiac risk factor management remained sub-optimal.

audits.t: An audit of clinically relevant abnormal laboratory parameters investigating athletes with persistent symptoms of fatigue.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Only 3 abnormal results contributed to a medical diagnosis for fatigue.

audits.t: Implementation and evaluation of a nursing home fall management program.
audits.st: 24-item falls process-of-care audit tool
audits.f: Restraint use 7.9%; fall rate 17.3 per 100 residents per month.
audits.c: Falls management programme: leadership support, falls coordinator and team, intensive education, and nurse specialist consultation.
audits.r2: Restraint use 4.4%; fall rate 16.4 per 100 residents per month; care process documentation improved significantly.

audits.t: Antibiotic misuse: a prospective clinical audit in a French university hospital.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 42 (34%) treatments unnecessary because of misdiagnosis and 36 (30%) inappropriate.

audits.t: Reducing referral-to-treatment waiting times in cancer patients using a multidisciplinary database.
audits.st: NHS Cancer Plan referral-to-treatment within 1 month
audits.f: Not reported in detail.
audits.c: Trust-wide Intranet database for tracking patients with automated pathology and radiology worklists
audits.r2: Highly significant reduction in patients whose treatment planning was delayed by unavailable investigations.

audits.t: National audit of continence care for older people: management of urinary incontinence.
audits.tp: Continence assessment and care in older inpatients
audits.st: National Service Framework for Older People: integrated continence services by April 2004; DH Good practice in continence services
audits.f: Returns from 141/326 (43%) PCTs, 159/196 (81%) secondary care trusts and 29/309 (9%) care homes; integrated services reported by 58% of PCTs, 48% of hospitals and 74% of care homes.

audits.t: Antenatal corticosteroid prescribing: a complete audit cycle.

audits.f: 0.64 courses per delivery at 24-36 weeks; repeat courses 5%; potentially effective courses 24%.

audits.r2: 1.18 courses per delivery; repeat courses <1%; potentially effective courses 35%.

audits.t: Compliance with the RCOG's guidelines on medical record keeping in female sterilisation: a complete audit cycle.
audits.st: RCOG guidelines on documentation during preoperative counselling for female sterilisation
audits.f: Failure to comply with RCOG guidelines (figures not given in abstract).
audits.r2: Described as a complete audit cycle; awareness of guidelines alone did not improve documentation (figures not given).

audits.t: Evidence-based practice in oral and maxillofacial surgery: audit of 1 training center.
audits.st: Best current evidence from Medline and Cochrane Library

audits.f: Coding error 40.7% for normal and 81.8% for abnormal obstetric conditions.

audits.t: Audit of nasal fracture management in accident and emergency in a district general hospital.
audits.st: Best practice for nasal fracture management
audits.f: 10 had nasal X-ray; 9 had no documentation of septal haematoma; 7 had no follow-up arranged.

audits.r2: Two nasal X-rays (looking for foreign bodies); all patients had septal haematoma documentation and appropriate follow-up.

audits.t: Using clinical audit, qualitative data from patients and feedback from general practitioners to decrease delay in the referral of suspected colorectal cancer.
audits.st: National referral guidelines for suspected colorectal cancer; seen within 2 weeks
audits.f: 67% (119/177) seen within 2 weeks; only 47% (71/151) of referral letters mentioned rectal examination.
audits.c: Local acceptance of national referral guidelines, faxable urgent referral pro forma developed with GPs, educational meetings and a waiting-time monitoring database.
audits.r2: Average waiting times dropped quickly and remained low (figures not given).

audits.t: Addressing sexually transmissible infection in HIV-positive patients. A clinical audit.
audits.tp: Sexual health care for people living with HIV
audits.st: No Australian guidelines exist
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Audit of acute admissions of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: inpatient management and outcome.
audits.st: Current COPD exacerbation guidelines
audits.f: Mean length of stay 3.4 days; 13% had assisted ventilation; 30-day mortality 8% and 12-month mortality 31%.

audits.t: Audit of under-14s who attend sexual health clinics in Gwent, South Wales, UK: identifying young people at risk of abuse and exploitation.

audits.t: The quality of operative note taking: an audit using the Royal College of Surgeons Guidelines as the gold standard.

audits.t: Point prevalence survey of antibiotic use in Scottish hospitals utilising the Glasgow Antimicrobial Audit Tool (GAAT).

audits.f: 1079 (28.3%) on antibiotics, 381 (35.3%) IV; IV route appropriate in 84% (IDP) and 84.8% (algorithm); agent appropriate in 80%; median IV duration 4 days.

audits.t: A good death certificate: improved performance by simple educational measures.
audits.st: Statutory requirements for death certification and correct information
audits.f: 19 (13.6%) certificates could not be shown to meet statutory criteria; minor errors and omissions in 58.6%.

audits.t: Audit of catheter urine culture requests.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Laboratory reports had no effect on catheter removal but aided antibiotic prescribing in symptomatic patients.

audits.t: Chlamydia screening and treatment in patients undergoing evacuation of retained products of conception or vaginal termination of pregnancy: an audit of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists' Guidelines in practice.
audits.st: RCOG guidelines on Chlamydia trachomatis screening and treatment before VTOP and ERPC
audits.f: VTOP group (n=30) screening and treatment satisfactory, aided by a proforma; ERPC group (n=30) had weaknesses in identifying and treating at-risk patients.

audits.t: Auditing the use of colposcopy versus general gynecology clinics to investigate women with postcoital or intermenstrual bleeding: a case for a new outpatient service.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 33 (55%) seen at general gynaecology clinic and 27 (45%) at colposcopy; Chlamydia testing deficient in both; no malignancy; CIN in 3 (11%) at colposcopy.

audits.t: [Medical audit of the clinical history of the infantile population treated at a primary care facility].
audits.st: Ten consensus criteria, 90% compliance as standard
audits.f: None of the criteria reached 90%; best were pregnancy 89%, vaccination 87.7%, breastfeeding 87%, birth weight 86.7%.

audits.t: Evaluating the accuracy of data entry in a regional colorectal cancer database: implications for national audit.
audits.st: ACPGBI colorectal cancer minimum dataset (18 key data points)
audits.f: 83% of data elements present in records; agreement between records and database 61% overall (70% preoperative, 47% operative).

audits.t: An audit of the impact of implementation of a stroke care pathway in an acute teaching hospital.
audits.st: UK National Stroke Audit 2002 benchmarks
audits.f: Management of stroke patients lacked organised and specialised care.
audits.c: Introduction of a stroke care pathway for general medical teams
audits.r2: Marked deficits persisted, including delays in brain imaging and aspirin administration, assessment of acute parameters and interdisciplinary care.

audits.t: Audit of exracapsular cataract extraction with posterior chamber intraocular lens implantation in a tertiary eye care center in Ethiopia.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: At two months 82 (30.4%) eyes had uncorrected acuity 6/18 or better; blind eyes fell from 94.9% to 4.4%; posterior capsule tear with vitreous loss 5.7%.

audits.t: Optimal dosing of bemiparin as prophylaxis against venous thromboembolism in surgery for cancer: an audit of practice.
audits.st: Consensus Guidelines for VTE management
audits.f: Surgeons rated 73 (37.1%) high risk, but guidelines rated 189 (95.9%) high risk; prophylaxis started postoperatively in 45 (22.8%).

audits.t: Emergency department follow-up of bereaved relatives: an audit of one particular service.
audits.tp: Bereavement follow-up after death in the emergency department
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: General practitioner (GP) cardiac troponin test requesting: findings from a clinical laboratory audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 45 of 46 results negative at the 99th percentile cut-off.

audits.t: [Audit of management of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease by general practitioner in Morrocco].
audits.st: International COPD guidelines
audits.f: Only 48.9% of GPs aware of international guidelines; 10.8% ordered spirometry; 30.5% managed patients themselves.

audits.t: Decisions to limit treatment in a neurosurgical unit: an aspect of audit of mortality.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Treatment-limiting decision noted in 67 of 131 deaths (51%); 40% made soon after admission (mean time to death 1.5 days, median 1 day); later decisions mean 6.8 days (median 5 days).

audits.t: A federal audit of the Belgian radiotherapy departments in breast cancer treatment.
audits.st: Federal College of Radiotherapy minimal documentation requirements for radiotherapy prescription and administration
audits.f: Complete pathology report in 99.5%; margins documented except in 6.5%; all but one prescription in line with evidence-based standards; mean surgery to radiotherapy delay 5.5 weeks.

audits.t: Urethral catheter audit.

audits.f: Catheter duration 1 to 38 days; in 13% duration could not be identified because of poor documentation.

audits.t: Who needs a palliative care consult?: the Hamilton Chart Audit tool.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Retrospective chart audit of 222 patients who died, using the Hamilton Chart Audit tool (results not given).

audits.t: Survey and audit of diabetes care in general practice in south London.

audits.t: Improving organisational systems for diabetes care in Australian Indigenous communities.
audits.tp: Diabetes care processes in primary care

audits.f: Baseline: 6-monthly HbA1c 41%, 3-monthly BP 63%, annual cholesterol 56%, biennial eye check 34%, 3-monthly foot check 20%; mean HbA1c 9.3%.
audits.c: Two annual cycles of assessment, feedback workshops, action planning and system changes.
audits.r2: HbA1c testing 74%, BP 76%, cholesterol 74%, eye check 54%, foot check 58%; mean HbA1c 8.9%.

audits.t: The infection control audit: the standardized audit as a tool for change.
audits.st: Standardised infection control audit covering layout, policies, knowledge and practice
audits.f: 17 audits involving 1525 employees; 257 recommendations made.
audits.c: Recommendations on clean/dirty separation, hand hygiene, signage, barriers and cleaning.

audits.t: Clinical audit documenting insertion date of peripheral intravenous cannulae.
audits.st: RCN and local guidelines: document insertion date of peripheral cannula; change uncomplicated cannula at 72 hours
audits.f: 13.8% of cannulae had been in place for more than 72 hours; poor documentation compliance despite staff awareness of guidelines.

audits.t: An audit of waiting times at a district general hospital sexual health department--how far are we from the 48 hours target?
audits.st: Government target: GUM appointment within 48 hours by 2008

audits.t: Audit of tetanus prevention knowledge and practices in accident and emergency departments in England.

audits.f: 75% had a local tetanus guideline but only 29% said it was always followed; 46.2% would give a booster if fifth dose >10 years ago, contrary to guidance; 22.1% would consider any wound tetanus prone.

audits.t: Audit of pneumocystis pneumonia in patients seen by the Christchurch Hospital rheumatology service over a 5-year period.

audits.f: 4 PCP cases, none on prophylaxis. Only 14 of 47 (29.7%) cyclophosphamide-treated patients received PCP prophylaxis. Annual incidence 0.17% with methotrexate (n=547) and 5.33% with cyclophosphamide; 9.50% with cyclophosphamide without prophylaxis.

audits.t: Improving sputum microscopy services for the diagnosis of tuberculosis in Peru and Bolivia.

audits.f: Peru: 31% (95% CI 27-35) of TB suspects assessed with sputum microscopy; Bolivia: 30% (95% CI 25-35) had at least two examinations.
audits.c: Clinical audit intervention with standard setting, performance measurement and feedback.
audits.r2: Availability of sputum microscopy results improved by 7% (95% CI 1-12) (further figures truncated in abstract).

audits.t: An audit on the management of gonorrhoea at the Whittall Street Clinic, Birmingham, UK.

audits.t: Organizational interventions to promote risk management in primary care: the experience in Warwickshire, England.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Practice manager audit of risk management activities used to derive a competence score (figures not given).
audits.c: Practice initiatives, significant event audit and Medical Defence Union workshops.
audits.r2: Improved risk management competence, especially in breadth of staff involved and formal recording systems.

audits.t: An audit of the value of pre-operative electrocardiograms before surgery (general anaesthetic) in a day surgery unit.
audits.st: ECG criteria for day-case surgery patients
audits.f: Only 24 of 60 patients meeting ECG criteria were referred; significant abnormality in 12.5%; none had surgery postponed or management changed.

audits.t: A pilot audit of the process of end-of-life decision-making in the intensive care unit.

audits.t: An audit on hysterectomy for benign diseases in public hospitals in Hong Kong.
audits.st: Standard of hysterectomy care (antibiotic prophylaxis, trainee supervision, complications)
audits.f: Prophylactic antibiotics given in 86.3% laparoscopic, 84.8% vaginal and 45.8% abdominal hysterectomies; 85.8% of abdominal and vaginal hysterectomies by trainees were supervised.

audits.t: The ADIPS pilot National Diabetes in Pregnancy Audit Project.
audits.st: ADIPS diabetes in pregnancy minimum dataset of 79 items (quality and outcome indicators)
audits.f: Substantial differences between sites in key quality and outcome indicators among 496 women (45 type 1, 43 type 2, 399 GDM).

audits.t: Specialist cardiology nurses audit post-MI community aftercare.
audits.st: National service framework for coronary heart disease (no target stated)
audits.f: not reported
