audits.t: The management of acute coronary syndrome patients across New Zealand in 2012: results of a third comprehensive nationwide audit and observations of current interventional care.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Echocardiogram 29%, exercise test 23%, CT angiogram 4%, coronary angiogram 33%; non-intervention centre patients less likely to have echocardiography (25 vs 31%) and had significant delays to invasive assessment.

audits.t: "State of the Nation"--the Society for Acute Medicine's Benchmarking Audit 2013 (SAMBA '13).
audits.tp: Acute medical unit function and flow
audits.st: Society for Acute Medicine clinical quality indicators
audits.f: 76% had early warning score within 30 minutes of admission; 95% seen by a competent decision maker within four hours; 79% seen by a consultant within the appropriate time.

audits.t: Methods to reduce prescription errors in ophthalmic medication.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Prescription errors 4.7% (29/623).

audits.t: Improving preterm infants' immunisation status: a follow-up audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Audit identified suboptimal immunisation status of preterm infants; figures not reported in the abstract.
audits.c: Preterm infant immunisation reminder sticker and feedback of the original audit findings to hospital staff.
audits.r2: Follow-up audit using the Australian Childhood Immunisation Register (n = 57, median age 2.5 years); immunisation results truncated in the abstract, which concludes vaccine delivery improved.

audits.t: Nurse-assessed metabolic monitoring: a file audit of risk factor prevalence and impact of an intervention to enhance measurement of waist circumference.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: None of the 60 audited files recorded waist circumference.
audits.c: Single nurse-education session (25 nurses) and change in assessment-form design.
audits.r2: 25 of 60 files (42%) recorded waist circumference (35 of 60, 58%, at 3 months).

audits.t: Starting treatment according to guidelines evaluation: a multicentre audit of HIV patients in the UK.
audits.st: British (BHIVA) and European guidelines on starting antiretroviral therapy
audits.f: 52 patients should have been on ART but were not; 23 of these declined despite advice.

audits.t: Sustainability and effectiveness of a quality improvement project to improve handoffs to night float residents in an internal medicine residency program.
audits.st: Local standardised handoff process and template
audits.f: Pre-intervention: morning handoff 59%; unreported overnight events 84%; uncertainty about decisions due to poor handoff 72%; missed content 69%; copy-and-paste behaviour 78%. Only 40% of residents reported regular morning handoff.
audits.c: Standardised handoff template and new handoff process, designed through process mapping, resident needs assessment and biweekly resident-faculty discussions.
audits.r2: Morning handoff 90% at 3 months and 89% at 9 months; unreported overnight events 58% and 50%; uncertainty 49% and 37%.

audits.t: COPD exacerbations -- a comparison of Irish data with European data from the ERS COPD Audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 35% received high-flow oxygen before admission; 18% cared for on a dedicated respiratory ward; 23% needed ventilatory support; median stay 7 days; 41% readmitted; 89% alive at 90 days.

audits.t: Retrospective audit of unplanned admissions to pediatric high dependency and intensive care after surgery.
audits.tp: Unplanned critical care admission after surgery
audits.st: Unplanned admission to intensive care after surgery as a recommended clinical indicator of perioperative safety
audits.f: 319 unplanned admissions to HDU/PICU (0.6%); 108 (34%) related to anaesthetic complications, a rate of 0.2%.
audits.c: Prompted a combined ENT and anaesthetic review of the care pathway for children after airway instrumentation.

audits.t: Audit to assess the quality of communication between operators and technicians in a fixed prosthodontic laboratory: educational and training implications.
audits.st: UK General Dental Council, EU Medical Devices Directive and British Society for Restorative Dentistry guidance
audits.f: 28% of prescriptions satisfactorily completed.
audits.c: Educational reminders on laboratory prescriptions for undergraduates and staff.

audits.t: A two-cycle prospective audit of temporal bone computed tomography scan requests: improving the clinical applicability of radiology reports.
audits.st: Proforma based on national guidelines for temporal bone CT requests
audits.f: 52% of reports were clinically relevant.
audits.c: New guidelines and training were implemented.
audits.r2: 94% of reports were clinically relevant (p value truncated in abstract).

audits.t: Venous thromboembolism: reducing the risk in a Role 3 setting.
audits.st: Clinical Guidelines for Operations on LMWH and graduated elasticated compression stocking prescription
audits.f: VTE risk assessment performed in 111/301 (36.9%).
audits.c: Multifaceted programme: physician and nurse education, pre-printed LMWH/GECS prescriptions and risk assessment stickers in the medication chart.

audits.t: Acute variceal haemorrhage in the United Kingdom: patient characteristics, management and outcomes in a nationwide audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 66% had endoscopy within 24 h; 64% received endoscopic therapy; before endoscopy 57% received PPIs, 44% vasopressors and 27% antibiotics; 26% rebled and 15% died by day 30.

audits.t: An assessment of the dementia CQUIN--an audit of improving compliance.
audits.st: Dementia CQUIN: screening for memory problems in patients over 75 admitted as emergencies
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Improvements to the screening process (details not given in abstract).

audits.t: Implementation of a quality improvement initiative in Belgian diabetic foot clinics: feasibility and initial results.
audits.st: Quality indicators of diabetic foot care (ulcer healing, amputation, off-loading, revascularisation)
audits.f: Ulcer healing rate at 6 months 49% in 2008.
audits.c: Audit-feedback with meetings and anonymous benchmarking of clinics; questionnaire revision.
audits.r2: Ulcer healing rate at 6 months 54% in 2011 (significant increase); 88% of plantar mid-foot ulcers off-loaded (P10-P90 64-100%); 42% of ischaemic limbs revascularised (P10-P90 22-69%).

audits.t: Pressure ulcer prevalence, use of preventive measures, and mortality risk in an acute care population: a quality improvement project.
audits.st: European Pressure Ulcer Advisory Panel protocol; Modified Norton Scale risk assessment
audits.f: Point prevalence of pressure ulcers 23%; 85 ulcers, most grade 1 (n = 39); 3% (n = 9) had been assessed with a risk assessment tool during the stay.

audits.t: An audit of preoperative fasting compliance at a major tertiary referral hospital in Singapore.
audits.st: Fasting at least six hours before surgery
audits.f: 128 patients fasted before surgery; 111 knew they needed to fast at least six hours; only 44.6% knew the reason for fasting; 10.8% thought fasting did not include beverages and sweets.

audits.t: Audit and feedback of antibiotic use: utilising electronic prescription data.
audits.st: Hospital antibiotic policy
audits.f: 0% compliant with the antibiotic policy.
audits.c: Individualised feedback letters on policy compliance emailed to 36 prescribers.

audits.t: Nationwide quality improvement in lung cancer care: the role of the Danish Lung Cancer Group and Registry.
audits.st: National clinical guidelines with process and result indicators
audits.f: 1-year overall survival 36.6%; 2-year 19.8%; 5-year 9.8%; 5-year survival after resection 39.5%.
audits.c: National guidelines, clinical quality database with quarterly reports and annual formal audit.

audits.t: TORCH screening in pregnancy. Where are we now? An audit of use in a tertiary level centre.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Commonest indication polyhydramnios (21%); 3 primary CMV infections; no confirmed gestational toxoplasma or rubella.

audits.t: Northern Territory Heart Failure Initiative-Clinical Audit (NTHFI-CA)-a prospective database on the quality of care and outcomes for acute decompensated heart failure admission in the Northern Territory: study design and rationale.
audits.st: Key performance indicators across six domains and five dimensions of healthcare
audits.f: not reported (study design and rationale paper)

audits.t: Clinical audit teaching in record-keeping for dental undergraduates at International Medical University, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
audits.st: Predetermined set of record-keeping criteria
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Clinical audit training with practical audit exercise, presentation of results and new record-keeping guidelines.
audits.r2: Statistically significant improvements in record keeping following audit training.

audits.t: Quality of prescribing for schizophrenia: evidence from a national audit in England and Wales.
audits.st: Six prescribing standards from the national clinical guidelines for schizophrenia
audits.f: 15.9% prescribed two or more antipsychotics; 10.1% prescribed above recommended limits; 23.7% receiving clozapine; 430/1073 (40.1%) with treatment resistance had no documented reason for no clozapine trial.

audits.t: Impact of audit and feedback and pay-for-performance interventions on pediatric hospitalist discharge communication with primary care providers.
audits.st: Documented communication with primary care provider at discharge
audits.f: 57% of charts had documented communication with PCPs.
audits.c: Audit and feedback, then a discharge communication measure added to hospitalists' incentive pay.
audits.r2: 84% during audit and feedback; 93% after adding financial incentive, sustained.

audits.t: Audits in real time for safety in critical care: definition and pilot study.
audits.st: Checklist of 37 literature-based safety measures agreed by Delphi method
audits.f: Improvement proportion related to audits reported in 83.78% of measures.

audits.t: Feasibility of a virtual learning collaborative to implement an obesity QI project in 29 pediatric practices.
audits.st: BMI percentile documentation, nutrition and activity counselling and follow-up of high-risk patients
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Virtual QI learning collaborative: educational webinars, monthly practice changes using PDSA cycles and periodic performance feedback.
audits.r2: Continuous improvement in BMI documentation, abnormal weight diagnosis, nutrition and activity screening and counselling, and follow-up of overweight and obese patients.

audits.t: Complication rate of posterior capsule rupture with vitreous loss during phacoemulsification at a Hawaiian cataract surgical center: a clinical audit.
audits.st: Published PCR with vitreous loss rates
audits.f: 23 of 3,339 cases had PCR with vitreous loss, incidence 0.68%.

audits.t: General practitioner ENT referral audit.
audits.tp: GP referrals to community mental health teams
audits.st: ICGP referral guidelines and standardised referral form (maximum 37 points)
audits.f: Average score 16/37; referrer details 75.42% (paediatric) and 72.9% (adult); clinical information 34% and 35%; only 32 letters mentioned examination findings.

audits.t: The PAR index for evaluation of treatment outcomes in orthodontics: a clinical audit of 50 cases.
audits.st: Mean PAR reduction above 70% and fewer than 5% of cases 'worse or no better'
audits.f: Mean PAR score fell from 25.64 +/- 11.73 to 1.78 +/- 2.79; mean reduction 93.36 +/- 9.02%; 46% improved, 54% greatly improved, none worse or no better.

audits.t: Radiology reporting of adrenal incidentalomas - who requires further testing?
audits.st: Guidelines recommending testing of adrenal incidentalomas to exclude functioning lesions and malignancy
audits.f: 17 (2.46%) patients with adrenal incidentalomas; 1.01% newly identified. Few tested to exclude a functional lesion.
audits.c: Decision pathway for adrenal lesions introduced in the radiology department.
audits.r2: 26 (2.01%) patients with adrenal incidentalomas; 0.95% newly identified. Few tested to exclude a functional lesion.

audits.t: Managing latent tuberculosis in UK renal transplant units: how does practice compare with published guidance?
audits.st: Recently published national guidance on latent TB infection management
audits.f: Three-quarters had a management protocol but only one-third of these were in line with guidance; almost half prescribed treatment at the wrong dose or duration.

audits.t: United Kingdom national paediatric bilateral cochlear implant audit: preliminary results.
audits.st: NICE 2009 guidance on bilateral cochlear implantation
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Improved obstetric safety through programmatic collaboration.
audits.st: Adverse Outcome Index and Weighted Adverse Outcome Score
audits.f: Adverse Outcome Index 10.7%; WAOS 3.9.
audits.c: Evidence-based protocols with audit and feedback, standardised education, mandatory electronic fetal monitoring training, enhanced in-house physician cover, electronic documentation, team training and simulation.
audits.r2: Adverse Outcome Index 6.2% (42% decrease, p < 0.001); WAOS 2.3 (p = 0.001).

audits.t: [Audit: medical record documentation among advanced cancer patients].
audits.st: List of items: diagnosis, prognosis, treatment, power of attorney, advance directives
audits.f: not reported
audits.r2: Documentation significantly improved for diagnosis (P = 0.01) and disease extension and treatment (P < 0.001).

audits.t: A survey of reporting of colorectal cancer in Scotland: compliance with guidelines and effect of proforma reporting.
audits.st: Royal College of Pathologists (2007) standards and NHS Quality Improvement Scotland standards
audits.f: Only three units met RCPath standards for rectal cancer reporting; non-proforma units failed minimum standards for serosal involvement (6%) and EMVI (24%); rectal cases with mean node count of 12 or more 56% (non-proforma) vs 81% (proforma).

audits.t: Adherence to antiemetic guidelines in patients with malignant glioma: a quality improvement project to translate evidence into practice.
audits.st: NCCN antiemetic guidelines (palonosetron plus dexamethasone for moderately emetic chemotherapy)
audits.f: Adherence 58%; CINV incidence 45%.
audits.c: Provider education session, risk-assessment tool with computerised standardised antiemetic order sets, and monthly audit-feedback.
audits.r2: Adherence increased to a sustained 90%; 75% (acute) and 84% (delayed) of patients had no CINV.

audits.t: Reinvigorating pediatric care in an academic family medicine practice.
audits.tp: Management of common childhood conditions in general practice
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Clinical quality interventions, provider education and competency work, and community marketing.

audits.t: A national house-staff audit of medical prophylaxis in medical patients for the PREVENTion of Venous ThromboEmbolism (PREVENT-VTE).
audits.st: ACCP guidelines for thromboprophylaxis in at-risk medical patients; aim to double the prophylaxis rate
audits.f: 549 (84%) at risk; 163 (29.7%) of at-risk patients received LMWH; mechanical prophylaxis in 75 (13.6%).
audits.c: Stickers placed in patient charts to alert physicians about thromboprophylaxis.
audits.r2: 487 (93%) at risk; 132 (27.1%) of at-risk patients received LMWH; mechanical prophylaxis in 86 (17.7%).

audits.t: Expanded HIV testing in high-prevalence areas in England: results of a 2012 audit of sexual health commissioners.
audits.st: UK HIV testing guidelines: routine testing of new GP registrants and general medical admissions in high-prevalence areas
audits.f: 11/35 (31%) had commissioned routine testing of new GP registrants and 5/35 (14%) routine testing of general medical admissions.

audits.t: Documented quality of care in certified colorectal cancer centers in Germany: German Cancer Society benchmarking report for 2013.
audits.st: German Cancer Society certification quality indicators
audits.f: Pre-treatment MDT presentation 91.8%, post-operative 98.1%; psycho-oncology 54.8%; social service counselling 77.1%; adjuvant chemotherapy (colon stage III) 73.7%; neoadjuvant therapy (rectum stage II-III) 80%; anastomotic leak colon 4.4%, rectum 7.6%; postoperative mortality 2.6%.

audits.t: Personalized technologist dose audit feedback for reducing patient radiation exposure from CT.
audits.st: Dose-length product from CT examinations
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Personalised dose audit feedback reports and education on dose-reduction strategies for technologists.
audits.r2: Abdominal CT DLP decreased 3% to 12% at intervention facilities but not at control; brain CT DLP decreased 7% to 12% at one intervention facility, unchanged at the other and increased at control.

audits.t: Remote auditing of radiotherapy facilities using optically stimulated luminescence dosimeters.
audits.st: Pass (optimal) within 2 SD (<=2.6%), fail beyond 3 SD (>3.9%) for OSLD audit
audits.f: TLD audit of 108 photon beams: mean deviation 0.0%, SD 1.8%; all Pass (Optimal Level).
audits.c: Replacement of TLD-based audit with optically stimulated luminescence dosimeter audit and tighter tolerances.
audits.r2: OSLD audit of 162 photon beams: mean deviation -0.2%, SD 1.4%; 94% Pass (Optimal Level), 6% Pass (Action Level).

audits.t: Results of a surgeon-directed quality improvement project on breast cancer surgery outcomes in South-Central Ontario.
audits.st: Surgeon-selected quality indicators (e.g. positive margins, preoperative core biopsy, specimen orientation, SLNB)
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Yearly audit and feedback of quality indicators, workshops and tailoring interviews (2005-2012).
audits.r2: Sustained improvement in positive margin rates, preoperative core biopsy, specimen orientation labelling and SLNB rates.

audits.t: Clinical audit of multidisciplinary care at a medium-sized hospital in Spain.
audits.st: National recommendations for multidisciplinary cancer care
audits.f: 64.5% discussed at a cancer conference at some point, but only 40% had documented MDT discussion before first treatment; pathological stage documented in 53.6%.

audits.t: Using audit to improve provision of analgesia for insertion of permanent pacemakers in children.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported
audits.r2: Significant reduction in the number of children receiving no analgesia (figures not given).

audits.t: Effective general practice: audit and feedback for the primary series of immunisations.
audits.st: Completion of the 5-month vaccination; NZ government and WHO immunisation targets
audits.f: Multifaceted audit: 46 of 48 (95.8%) fully immunised, 2 of 48 (4.2%) partially immunised; 25 of 48 (52.1%) immunised on time.

audits.t: Audit of cesarean delivery in Burkina Faso.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Referral not medically justified for 35 women; caesarean indications not confirmed by an obstetrician in 12.0%.

audits.t: Disaster easily averted? Data confidentiality and the hospital desktop computer.
audits.st: Confidential data protection regulations (no unprotected confidential information on desktop)
audits.f: 55% of ward computers had accessible unprotected confidential information on the desktop.
audits.c: Mandatory online learning module on data protection and confidentiality for clinical staff.
audits.r2: 26% of computers had unprotected confidential information.

audits.t: Audit and Feedback-Focused approach to Evidence-based Care in Treating patients with pneumonia in hospital (AFFECT Study).
audits.st: Local best-practice pneumonia treatment algorithms based on guidelines and local antibiogram
audits.f: Adherence to treatment algorithms 10% (2/21).
audits.c: Local treatment algorithms developed; presentation to hospitalists on antimicrobial stewardship and baseline audit findings (November 2012).

audits.t: Supporting clinical practice behavior change among neurologic physical therapists: a case study in knowledge translation.
audits.st: Appropriate use of nonsupported gait training for eligible patients with hemiparesis
audits.f: 50% of eligible patients trained with nonsupported gait training.
audits.c: Quarterly staff meetings, group and individual dialogue, chart audit with aggregate feedback, reminders, role modelling and clinical consultation.
audits.r2: 73% of eligible patients trained with nonsupported gait training.

audits.t: An educational approach to improve outcomes in acute kidney injury (AKI): report of a quality improvement project.
audits.st: Local AKI guidelines
audits.f: 26% of clinicians aware of local AKI guidelines.
audits.c: Multifaceted education: lectures, small group case-based teaching and an interactive web-based resource.

audits.t: An audit of the efficacy of a structured handover tool in obstetric anaesthesia.
audits.st: All patients in the four SAFE categories (Sick, At-risk, Follow-ups, Epidurals) should be handed over
audits.f: 49% of relevant cases handed over.
audits.c: SAFE handover tool: a proforma for documenting patients in four anaesthetically relevant categories.
audits.r2: 79% of relevant cases handed over; patients four times more likely to be handed over.

audits.t: Audits of the quality of perioperative antibiotic prophylaxis in Shandong Province, China, 2006 to 2011.
audits.st: Chinese National Antibiotic Guideline (indication, choice, dose, timing, duration)
audits.f: 14,261 of 14,525 procedures (98.2%) received prophylaxis; non-compliance with indication 18.6%, duration 26.7%, timing of first dose 30.3%; all steps correct in only 9.4%.

audits.t: Pleural procedures and patient safety: a national BTS audit of practice.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 21% of centres ran a specialist pleural clinic; 71% had a nominated chest drain safety lead; 20% had thoracic surgery on site.

audits.t: Urinary tract infections in multiple sclerosis: under-diagnosed and under-treated? A clinical audit at a large University Hospital.
audits.tp: Urinary tract infection management in multiple sclerosis
audits.st: NICE Clinical Guideline 148 (lower urinary tract symptoms in neurogenic bladder dysfunction)
audits.f: 21 of 118 patients had abnormal urine dipsticks; methylprednisolone was delayed pending culture and, if infected, until antibiotics were completed.

audits.t: Improving the availability of clinical history accompanying radiographic examinations in a large pediatric radiology department.
audits.st: 95% of clinical histories to contain what-when-where elements
audits.f: 38% (76/200) had a complete clinical history.
audits.c: Technologists supplemented referrers' history; automated weekly audits with group then individual performance reports; quarterly results built into technologists' performance goals.

audits.t: UK Renal Registry 17th Annual Report: Chapter 8 Biochemical Variables amongst UK Adult Dialysis Patients in 2013: National and Centre-specific Analyses.
audits.st: UK Renal Association clinical practice guideline audit measures for phosphate, adjusted calcium (2.2–2.5 mmol/L), PTH (16–72 pmol/L) and bicarbonate
audits.f: Phosphate in range: 57% HD, 62% PD; adjusted calcium 2.2–2.5 mmol/L: 78% HD and PD; PTH 16–72 pmol/L: 57% HD, 63% PD; bicarbonate measure met: 59% HD, 79% PD.

audits.t: UK Renal Registry 18th Annual Report: Chapter 11 2014 Multisite Dialysis Access Audit in England, Northern Ireland and Wales and 2013 PD One Year Follow-up: National and Centre-specific Analyses.
audits.st: Renal Association targets: 65% of incident HD patients on AVF; 85% of prevalent HD patients on AVF
audits.f: 20.1% started on PD, 27.8% AVF, 1.0% AVG, 27.1% tunnelled line, 24.0% non-tunnelled line; AVF first access ranged 10–54% between centres; 8 of 49 centres close to 65% target; 31 of 38 centres 2 or 3 SD below 85% prevalent target.

audits.t: Significant reduction in red blood cell transfusions in a general hospital after successful implementation of a restrictive transfusion policy supported by prospective computerized order auditing.
audits.st: Single-unit RBC transfusion for non-bleeding inpatients at Hb not more than 7 g/dL
audits.f: 60.8 RBC units transfused per 1000 patient-days.
audits.c: Revised restrictive transfusion policy with computerised order entry decision support (prospective order auditing on latest Hb) and removal of single-click 2-unit ordering.

audits.t: American Society for Radiation Oncology's Performance Assessment for the Advancement of Radiation Oncology Treatment: A practical approach for informing practice improvement.
audits.st: PAAROT version 2.5 quality measures
audits.f: Over 80% adoption for measures such as history and physical, plan review and consent; composite measure mean 65% (range 0-100%); pain screening with standard scale 58%.

audits.t: Putting an eye on cytological specimens: an audit of the clinical impact of thyroid fine-needle aspiration in different health care settings.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Preprocedure clinical information available for 157 of 2005 nodules (7.8%); nondiagnostic GP 11.6% vs endocrinology 7.5%.

audits.t: An audit of new asthma guidance for school staff.
audits.st: Local school asthma guidance policy standards
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Asthma guidance for schools introduced in 2009 via cluster head meetings, with school nurse staff training and support.
audits.r2: Guidance improved school staff knowledge of asthma and confidence to manage an acute attack.

audits.t: An audit to review the characteristics and management of placenta praevia at Aberdeen Maternity Hospital, 2009-2011.
audits.st: RCOG guidelines on placenta praevia
audits.f: Four-fifths major praevias; diagnosis mostly transabdominal; most received steroids and ferrous sulphate; most delivered after 36 weeks with senior support and cell salvage.

audits.t: Six to success: improving primary care management of pediatric overweight and obesity.
audits.st: 23 guideline-recommended identification, assessment and prevention measures for overweight/obese children
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Six to Success weight management programme based on the Chronic Care Model.
audits.r2: Significant improvements in correct diagnosis, physical examination, lifestyle assessment, motivational interviewing and prevention strategies.

audits.t: Changes in the care of non-small-cell lung cancer after audit and feedback: the Florida initiative for quality cancer care.
audits.st: 16 quality-of-care indicators for non-small-cell lung cancer
audits.f: Brain staging for stage III NSCLC 57.8%; chemotherapy flow sheet 89.2%.
audits.c: Feedback of 2006 audit results to practices in 2008; practices independently took steps to improve.
audits.r2: Significant increase in 5 of 16 indicators; brain staging 82.8% (P = .001); chemotherapy flow sheet 97.0%.

audits.t: Audit on preoperative fasting of elective surgical patients in an African academic medical center.
audits.st: AAGBI, ASA, RCOA and RCN preoperative fasting guidelines
audits.f: Mean fasting 19.60 h for food (5-96) and 12.72 h for fluid (5-19); 92% fasted from food and 95% from fluid longer than recommended.

audits.t: Practice and documentation of palliative sedation: a quality improvement initiative.
audits.st: International palliative sedation standards
audits.f: No specific documentation of sedation initiation in 60 (64.5%), refractory symptoms in 43 (46.2%) and informed consent in 38 (40.9%) charts.

audits.t: Effectiveness of two types of intervention on antibiotic prescribing in respiratory tract infections in Primary Care in Spain. Happy Audit Study.
audits.tp: Antibiotic prescribing for respiratory tract infection
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: not reported (GPs registered all patients with RTIs)
audits.c: Meetings presenting results, training on RTI guidelines, patient brochures, and for the full intervention group workshops on and provision of rapid antigen detection and CRP point-of-care tests.
audits.r2: Odds ratio of antibiotic prescribing 0.50 (95% CI 0.44-0.57) in the full intervention group and 0.99 (0.89-1.10) in the partial intervention group.

audits.t: Using a complex audit tool to measure workload, staffing and quality in district nursing.
audits.st: Safer Nursing Care Tool methodology and quality standards, benchmarked against Scotland
audits.f: 4 of 6 localities had a heavy workload index; patient acuity and dependency were high.

audits.t: Auditing a breast MRI practice: performance measures for screening and diagnostic breast MRI.
audits.st: No established breast MRI benchmarks; cancer detection rate, PPV and abnormal interpretation rate
audits.f: Cancer detection rate 14 per 1,000 screening and 47 per 1,000 diagnostic breast MRI examinations.

audits.t: Audit of pediatric transfusion practices in a tertiary care hospital.
audits.st: British Committee for Standards in Haematology and American Association of Blood Banks guidelines
audits.f: Appropriate use of blood components 59.65% (2,145 units in 1,819 episodes); whole blood most appropriately transfused (82.9%).

audits.t: Audit and feedback intervention: An examination of differences in chiropractic record-keeping compliance.
audits.st: Quality indicators of chiropractic record documentation (5 compliance areas, 11 objectives)
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Audit-feedback report alone versus feedback report with one-to-one educational consultation.
audits.r2: Significant increase in mean compliance in 2 of 5 compliance areas and 1 of 11 compliance objectives.

audits.t: A state-wide quality improvement system utilising nurse-led clinics for clozapine management.
audits.st: Clozapine monitoring guidelines
audits.f: Mortality from non-malignant physical illness averaged 5 deaths per year before the interventions.
audits.c: Standardised forms, computer-based monitoring and alerting, nurse-led clinics for stable consumers and a regular training programme.
audits.r2: Mortality from non-malignant physical illness reduced to one death; nurse-led monitoring reduced medical outpatient appointments by 119 per week.

audits.t: Severe postpartum haemorrhage after vaginal delivery: a statistical process control chart to report seven years of continuous quality improvement.
audits.st: Criteria-based audit of recommended procedures for severe postpartum haemorrhage
audits.f: Severe PPH prevalence 1.2% of vaginal deliveries.
audits.c: Quarterly clinical audit meetings analysing all severe PPH cases with feedback using statistical process control charts.
audits.r2: Severe PPH prevalence 0.6% of vaginal deliveries (50% reduction).

audits.t: Indwelling urinary catheter use at the end of life: a retrospective audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 63% had an indwelling catheter; catheter insertion and care documentation present in 75%; 75% had continence screening on admission.

audits.t: Quality improvement of metabolic control for patients with type 2 diabetes treated at a general hospital: a quantitative open cohort study.
audits.tp: Type 2 diabetes care in primary care
audits.st: Goals for metabolic risk factors (blood pressure, LDL cholesterol, HbA1c)
audits.f: Mean systolic BP 142 mmHg; LDL 2.6 mmol/L; HbA1c 8.5% (64 mmol/mol).
audits.c: Stepped-care treatment intensification towards metabolic goals, supported by a database.
audits.r2: Mean systolic BP 132 mmHg; LDL 2.1 mmol/L; HbA1c 7.6% (57 mmol/mol).

audits.t: Paediatric type 1 diabetes in Ireland--results of the first national audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Insulin pump use 0 to 42% by centre; clinic mean HbA1c 8.2 to 9.4% (66.1 to 79.2 mmol/mol).

audits.t: Medication management for elderly patients in an academic primary care setting: a quality improvement project.
audits.st: National Patient Safety Goal on medication reconciliation
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Education of providers, staff and patients on medication management.
audits.r2: Improvement in all four outcomes: medication reconciliation, medication list accuracy, inappropriate medication use and duplicate therapy.

audits.t: Medication Safety: an audit of medication discrepancies in transferring type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients from Australian primary care to tertiary ambulatory care.
audits.tp: Medication discrepancies at transitions of care
audits.st: not reported
