audits.f: not reported
audits.r2: Significant increase in documentation, cannula cleansing, glove use, site selection and hand hygiene; fewer recannulations.

audits.t: Service Improvements and Workload Increases: Royal College of Radiologists (RCR) Re-Audit of Curative Intent Radiotherapy for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
audits.st: Guideline-recommended radical radiotherapy for NSCLC (RCR 2013 audit standards)
audits.f: Under-treatment and marked variability between networks; 4-dimensional planning used in 33%
audits.c: Various national and local interventions (not detailed)
audits.r2: 93% of centres returned data; radical radiotherapy up 70% since 2013; waits 20% longer (p = 0.02); 79% of PET/CT scans outside desirable timeframe; 4-dimensional planning 90%

audits.t: Achieving optimal cord management: a multidisciplinary quality improvement initiative.
audits.tp: Delayed cord clamping in preterm births
audits.st: Optimal cord management (cord clamping delayed at least 60 s) for infants <34 weeks; aim at least 40%
audits.f: 32.4% of infants <34 weeks received optimal cord management (NNAP data had shown 12.1%).
audits.c: Multidisciplinary QI team (neonatal, obstetric, midwifery and anaesthetic staff) using quality improvement methodology.

audits.t: A retrospective audit of adult and paediatric anaphylaxis management from two Australian metropolitan mixed emergency departments.
audits.st: Optimal anaphylaxis management including adrenaline auto-injector and action plan at discharge
audits.f: Pre-hospital adrenaline 36% adults, 43% children; ED adrenaline 35% adults, 27% children; AAI at discharge 123/210 (59%) adults, 57/91 (63%) children; action plan 61/206 (30%) adults, 30/90 (33%) children.

audits.t: Detection of and response to gender-based violence: a quality improvement project across three secondary mental health services in London.
audits.tp: Gender-based violence enquiry in mental health services
audits.st: Documented enquiry about exposure to gender-based violence in female and non-binary patients' records (no target stated)
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Brief, cost-neutral staff engagement and education interventions at service, borough and trust levels.
audits.r2: Documented GBV enquiry increased by 30% (HTT), 15% (ward) and 7% (D&A).

audits.t: Audit of hemostatic clip use after colorectal polyp resection in an academic endoscopy unit.
audits.st: Prophylactic clip closure unnecessary after cold resection
audits.f: Clips after cold resection: 41.7% of lesions ≥20 mm, 19.3% of 10-19 mm, 2.8% of 1-9 mm; overall 3.9% after cold vs 71.1% after electrocautery; 62.4% of all clips placed after cold resection.

audits.t: Caring for hearts and minds: a quality improvement approach to individualized developmental care in the cardiac intensive care unit.
audits.tp: Developmental care in neonatal and paediatric intensive care
audits.st: NIDCAP individualised developmental care
audits.f: 357 NIDCAP bedside audits collected; baseline figures not given in abstract.
audits.c: PDSA cycles with key driver diagram and multidisciplinary interventions.
audits.r2: Improvement over time in lighting, sound, bedding, self-regulation, positioning and caregiving facilitation.

audits.t: The Royal College of Radiologists National Vulvar Cancer Audit.
audits.st: RCR guidance: 95% compliance with RCR dose/fractionation; 40% IMRT use; 100% radical patients treated as category 1; 95% gap compensation for category 1 patients
audits.f: 98% of radical patients received IMRT (target exceeded); dose/fractionation compliance adjuvant/definitive 80%/43% primary, 80%/86% elective nodes, 21%/21% pathological nodes; 78% treated as category 1; 27% used gap compensation

audits.t: Project to improve the management of the head injury patients presenting to the emergency department.
audits.st: Over 90% of high-risk head injury patients assessed by an ED clinician within 15 minutes of arrival
audits.f: 31% assessed within 15 minutes; average time to CT head 69 min; CT reporting 98 min; time to decision 6 hours 48 min.
audits.c: New adult head injury pathway with risk stratification, modified imaging and patient transport, and early decision making (PDSA cycles).
audits.r2: 63% assessed within 15 minutes; average time to CT head 53 min; CT reporting 71 min; time to decision 4 hours 24 min.

audits.t: Incorporating clinician insight and care plans into an audit and feedback initiative for antipsychotic prescribing to Medicaid-enrolled youth in Philadelphia.
audits.tp: Psychotropic prescribing in children and young people
audits.st: Antipsychotic prescribing report card measures (polypharmacy, medication management, concurrent outpatient behavioural health services)
audits.f: Many youth on antipsychotics lacked proper medication management or concurrent outpatient behavioural health services; polypharmacy rare.
audits.c: Audit and feedback report card with clinician feedback loop, introduced in 2020.
audits.r2: Modest reduction in polypharmacy and large reduction in youth with one or more antipsychotic fills among report card recipients; other measures unchanged.

audits.t: Improving Prostate MR Image Quality in Practice-Initial Results From the ACR Prostate MR Image Quality Improvement Collaborative.
audits.st: PI-QUAL score ≥4; target at least 85% of examinations
audits.f: Mean weekly rate of examinations with PI-QUAL ≥4 was 67% (range 60%-74%) at baseline
audits.c: PDSA cycles: MR protocol adjustments, patient preparation instructions, personnel training and an auditing process

audits.t: Time to ECG diagnosis delays inter-hospital transfer to revascularization in STEMI patients presenting to a regional emergency department: a five-year audit.
audits.st: Door-to-balloon time ≤120 min; door-to-ECG time ≤10 min
audits.f: Median door-to-balloon time 117.5 min (IQR 99.3-170.8); 52.5% met the ≤120 min target; median door-to-ECG 18.0 min (IQR 9.0-46.8), 28.8% met the ≤10 min target.

audits.t: Quality improvement project - Reducing the inadvertent prescribing of unopposed estrogen in primary care Dr Liz Horrocks Banstead PCN.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Several cases of inadvertent unopposed oestrogen exposure identified, due to prescribing, dispensing and patient understanding factors (no figures given)
audits.c: Proposed EMIS IT changes (awaited), pharmacist education, alert stickers at dispensing, patient education and a short video for clinicians

audits.t: Impact of conducting hand hygiene audits during the COVID-19 pandemic in an intensive care unit at a tertiary care centre in Kerala, India.
audits.st: WHO five moments for hand hygiene
audits.f: Complete adherence 47%, partial 19%, total adherence 66%; monthly total adherence rose from 62.2% to 72.2%.
audits.c: Hand hygiene auditing with timely feedback.

audits.t: Shortening treatment duration for uncomplicated community acquired pneumonia to align with best practice guidelines in a large academic paediatric emergency department.
audits.st: Updated recommendation for 5-day antibiotic therapy for community-acquired pneumonia
audits.f: 5-day antibiotic prescription rate 3%.
audits.c: Educational outreach, data sharing, on-site reminders and audit-and-feedback.

audits.t: Compliance and adherence to hand hygiene practices for effective infection control.
audits.st: WHO hand hygiene guidelines
audits.f: Total hand hygiene compliance 52.3%
audits.c: Action plan with monthly re-audits and feedback
audits.r2: Total compliance 83.3% (p < 0.05); overall compliance 75% across 2,732 moments June to September

audits.t: Reducing Improper and Missed Peri-Procedure Antibiotics Prescriptions in a Regional Oncology Centre.
audits.st: Hospital peri-procedural antibiotic guidelines
audits.f: 6/82 (7.3%) did not receive correct peri-procedural antibiotics; adherence 93%.
audits.c: Formal and informal teaching on peri-procedure antibiotics and ensuring the full guideline was available in clinical areas.
audits.r2: 1/25 (4%) did not receive antibiotics per guideline; adherence 96% (p = 0.50).

audits.t: Improving door-to-analgesia timing in musculoskeletal injuries in an academic emergency department in India: a quality improvement project.
audits.tp: Time to analgesia in the emergency department
audits.st: Aim to reduce time to first analgesia by 30% from baseline
audits.f: Median door-to-analgesia 55.5 min (IQR 25.75-108).
audits.c: Pain score at triage, fast-tracking of moderate-severe pain, resident awareness sessions, pain management protocol and prescription audits.

audits.t: Applying the British Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons quality outcomes metrics to a regional Australian oncology and reconstructive service: benchmarking the data to audit clinical outcomes in emerging, regional, and small-volume centres.
audits.tp: Head and neck cancer care standards
audits.st: BAOMS Quality and Outcomes in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (QOMS) outcome metrics with alert and alarm levels
audits.f: not reported

audits.t: Basic life support training for intensive care unit nurses at a general hospital in Tabriz, Iran: a best practice implementation project.
audits.st: 13 evidence-based JBI audit criteria for BLS training (American Heart Association guidelines)
audits.f: Gaps between current and best practice in 9 of 13 criteria.
audits.c: Human simulator manikin, nurse education programme, cardiopulmonary-cerebral resuscitation department, skills laboratory and continuous BLS education.

audits.t: Enhancing WHO prescription writing guideline adherence through an educational intervention: a quality improvement study of Azad Jammu and Kashmir.
audits.st: WHO guidelines for prescription writing
audits.f: Baseline compliance with WHO prescription elements (figures not given in abstract).
audits.r2: Compliance improved; greatest gains in documenting allergy status (62%) and direction of drug administration (40%); improvements in treatment duration (>10%), weight, registration number, diagnosis and follow-up advice.

audits.t: Enhancing Procedure Documentation in Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU): A Quality Improvement Initiative at a Tertiary Neonatal Hospital.
audits.st: EMR procedure documentation standards
audits.f: Procedure encounter placement 81%; nursing documentation 11 (52.4%).
audits.c: Tailored educational sessions on EMR use and documentation standards.

audits.t: Turnaround Time of the Hematology Results of Cancer Patients During the COVID-19 Pandemic: An Opportunity to Initiate a Quality Improvement Process.
audits.st: Intra-laboratory CBC turnaround time (analyses under 90 minutes)
audits.f: Median intra-lab TAT 56 minutes (IQR 36-80); 82% of analyses performed in under 90 minutes.
audits.c: Improvement flowchart and new request form proposed (colour-coded forms and labels, sampling time recorded, dedicated oncology chain, HIS alarms, rapid telephone results); not yet re-measured.

audits.t: Suboptimal factors in maternal and newborn care for refugees: Lessons learned from perinatal audits in the Netherlands.
audits.st: National perinatal audit identifying suboptimal factors in care (Three Delays Model)
audits.f: 29 suboptimal factors identified; all 53 cases contained suboptimal factors; in 67.9% at least one most likely or probably contributed to the adverse outcome

audits.t: Outcomes Following Colorectal Cancer Surgeries at the Basildon and Thurrock University Hospital.
audits.st: National Bowel Cancer Audit (NBOCA) national averages (90-day mortality 2.7% in 2019/20)
audits.f: 30-day mortality 1/141 (0.71%); 90-day mortality 2/141 (1.4%) vs national 2.7%; 30-day complications 30 (21.3%), six Clavien-Dindo grade III; mean length of stay 7.8 days.

audits.t: Outcomes after gastrectomy according to the Gastrectomy Complications Consensus Group (GCCG) in the Dutch Upper GI Cancer Audit (DUCA).
audits.st: Gastrectomy Complications Consensus Group (GCCG) definitions and international benchmarks for expert gastrectomy care
audits.f: Outcomes comparable with GCCG European cohort (N = 1349) but both exceeded the international benchmark for expert gastrectomy care; minimally invasive surgery 80.6% vs 19.6%.

audits.t: Timely Review and Communication of Histopathology Reports Following Appendicectomy: Insights from a Two-Cycle Clinical Audit.
audits.st: NHS England 2016 patient safety guidance on timely review and communication of histopathology results
audits.f: 207 (49.52%) reviewed within 15 days and 47 (11.24%) at 16-30 days; 116 (27.75%) unreviewed; communication documented in 67 (16.02%).
audits.c: Presentation at clinical governance meeting and implementation of agreed recommendations and protocols.
audits.r2: 38 (77.55%) reviewed within 15 days and 10 (20.4%) at 16-30 days; communication documented in 16 (32.65%).

audits.t: Long-Term Sustainability of Peri-Operative Infection Control Practices: Implementation of "Clean Cut," a Checklist-Based Quality Improvement Program in India.
audits.st: Six critical perioperative infection prevention and control standards (Clean Cut programme)
audits.f: Teams complied with a mean of 3.56 of the six critical infection control components at baseline.
audits.c: Clean Cut programme: surveillance, audits and infection prevention training with a checklist for 6 months, then no active oversight.
audits.r2: Compliance rose to a mean of 4.66 of six components after implementation, with reduced SSI rates in the short term.

audits.t: An audit of inpatient insulin prescriptions - how error relates to information source.
audits.st: Accurate inpatient insulin prescription matching the patient's regimen
audits.f: Only 44/85 (52%) patients or carers recalled being asked about insulin; overall insulin prescription error rate about one in four.

audits.t: Data quality assessment of the Enhanced Gonococcal Antimicrobial Surveillance Programme (EGASP), Thailand, 2015-2021.
audits.st: Data accuracy and completeness of source records against database
audits.f: Across five audit cycles overall accuracy ranged 93.6% to 99.4% and completeness 95.0% to 99.9%.
audits.c: Corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for incorrect and incomplete data.
audits.r2: Concordance >85% for all elements in all cycles except two laboratory elements in two cycles, which significantly improved after CAPA.

audits.t: Structured Reporting of Superficial Soft Tissue Masses on Ultrasonography: A Closed-Loop Clinical Audit From a Tertiary Care Hospital in Pakistan.
audits.tp: Structured ultrasound reporting of soft tissue masses
audits.st: Royal College of Radiologists structured reporting criteria
audits.f: 41.5% compliance.
audits.c: Regular presentations, resident briefing, displayed parameters and preformed structured reporting templates.

audits.t: Public health audit of vaccine cold chain management in general practice and community pharmacy in Western Australia.
audits.st: National Vaccine Storage Guidelines
audits.f: 420 GPs (89.6%) and 276 pharmacies (82%) responded; over 70% met all procedural and emergency storage criteria; data logger used by 98.1% of GPs and 97.0% of pharmacies
audits.c: Electronic audit with automated feedback and individual clinical nurse specialist follow-up

audits.t: Surgical Audit for the Outcome of Primary Rhegmatogenous Retinal Detachment Repair in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
audits.st: International success rates for primary rhegmatogenous retinal detachment repair
audits.f: Primary reattachment 77.1% (54 eyes); final reattachment 95.7%; mean postoperative VA 6/18; 30% achieved 6/12 or better; redetachment 16/70 (22.8%).

audits.t: Assessment and management of post-surgical pain in adult patients undergoing thoracic surgery: a best practice implementation project.
audits.st: Nine JBI audit criteria for post-operative pain assessment and management
audits.f: Poor compliance with best practice (figures not given).
audits.c: Strategies to address non-compliance, including health education for patients and caregivers and use of validated pain scales.
audits.r2: Health education up to 80%; pain measurement on admission and post-surgery 91%; pre-operative assessment guiding pain management at discharge below 50%.

audits.t: Acute frailty services: results of a national day of care survey.
audits.st: Use of a validated frailty assessment tool (clinical frailty scale) within 24 h of admission in patients aged 70 and over
audits.f: 1626 (45.1%) patients aged 70 and over assessed with a validated frailty tool; 117 (90.0%) hospitals reported using a validated tool and 57 (42.2%) had an acute frailty unit.

audits.t: Audit-based corrective and preventive actions to reduce wastage of blood components at a single blood center: A quality improvement study.
audits.st: Blood centre key performance indicators (QC failure, TTI positivity, component discards)
audits.f: Overall discard rate about 5% at the start of the first cycle.
audits.c: Corrective and preventive actions on preparation, inventory management and issue over four cycles.
audits.r2: Discard rate reduced to about 3% by end of four cycles (statistically significant).

audits.t: Medication Adherence in Adults with Chronic Diseases in Primary Healthcare: A Quality Improvement Project.
audits.st: JBI evidence-based best practice audit criteria (GRiP)
audits.f: Several criteria at 0% compliance at baseline.
audits.c: Feedback via GRiP tool, nursing team engagement and education on medication adherence strategies.
audits.r2: Compliance improved significantly, with many criteria reaching 100%.

audits.t: An audit of central venous catheter insertion and management practices in two French university hospitals.
audits.st: French guidelines for prevention of CVC-related infections
audits.f: Hand hygiene prerequisites respected by 90%; hand hygiene before equipment preparation 86%, repeated before infusion 59%; gloves when necessary 46.7%; rinsing 75.6%.

audits.t: Improving the Quality and Standardization of Operative Notes in a Tertiary Regional ENT Department: A Closed-Loop Audit.
audits.st: Royal College of Surgeons standards for operative notes (18 criteria)
audits.f: Lack of adherence to RCS standards (figures not reported in abstract).
audits.c: Operative note proforma modified to include the 18 RCS criteria.
audits.r2: Significant improvement in documentation quality and adherence to standards (P value truncated in abstract).

audits.t: Awareness of radiation risks by medical students & referrers requesting radiological examinations in the North of Scotland: an audit.
audits.st: RCR audit criteria: referrers should have adequate knowledge of radiation doses and risks; target 90%
audits.f: Only 17.79% (n=37) scored over 50% on the knowledge assessment; median score 2.5/9 (27.78%); target not met.

audits.t: Quality of melatonin use in children and adolescents: findings from a UK clinical audit.
audits.st: Evidence-based clinical practice standards for melatonin prescribing
audits.f: Non-drug intervention tried before starting in 279/409 (68%); therapeutic response assessed in 36% early and 31% long-term; side effects reviewed in 46% and 43%; planned treatment breaks documented in 317 (13%) on long-term treatment.

audits.t: Induction chemotherapy backbone in frail patients with advanced NSCLC treated with chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab: a single institution retrospective audit of dose intensities from modified regimens.
audits.tp: Chemotherapy dose intensity in frail lung cancer patients
audits.st: Received dose intensity ≥85% defined as adequate delivery
audits.f: Non-squamous: RDIs of 86% carboplatin and 75% pemetrexed; squamous: 90% received modified regimens, overall RDI 73.5%

audits.t: Precision in practice: An audit study on low-flow anesthesia techniques with desflurane and sevoflurane for cost-effective and sustainable care.
audits.tp: Low-flow anaesthesia and volatile agent use
audits.st: Hospital standard for low-flow fresh gas flow during maintenance
audits.f: Mean maintenance FGFR 0.45 ± 0.88 L/min; 94.29% maintained on low-flow rates. Desflurane 12.17 vs 43.12 ml/MAC hour and sevoflurane 3.48 vs 5.20 ml/MAC hour for low vs high flow.

audits.t: Clinical Audit of Assisting Renal Biopsy Procedure Performed in Nephrology Unit of a Tertiary Care Hospital with a View to Develop Standard Nursing Procedure Protocol.
audits.st: Standard nursing practices checklist; acceptable practice ≥80% in each dimension
audits.f: None of the 19 nurses (0%) achieved acceptable practice across all dimensions; 73.7% had no special nephrology training.

audits.t: [Audit of Antibiotic Dispensing in Community Pharmacy (Happy Patient Project)].
audits.st: Audit Project Odense methodology for antibiotic dispensing
audits.f: Triple safety check (interactions, contraindications, allergies) in 15% of dispensations; treatment duration information given in 62.3%; no advice at all in 24.6%; pharmacist agreed with treatment in 81.7%.

audits.t: Ensuring Adherence to 2023 National Institute of Excellence (Nice) Guidelines for CT Scans in Head Injury Cases in a Teaching Hospital in Basra, Iraq: A Clinical Audit.
audits.st: NICE head injury guideline NG232 (2023)
audits.f: 59.3% of scans requested outside NICE guidance; one-hour indication scans 32%.

audits.t: Improving the systematic screening and documentation of mental capacity for patients with severe brain injury: The Mental Capacity Screening assessment tool (MCScreen).
audits.st: Mental Capacity Act 2005 assessment and documentation of capacity
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Introduced a mental capacity screening tool (MCScreen) and documentation system to stratify patients by likely capacity.
audits.r2: Implementation improved the consistency of capacity assessment and documentation (no figures given in abstract).

audits.t: Promoting sleep and rest in hospitalized children: a best practice implementation project.
audits.st: JBI evidence-based audit criteria for promoting sleep and rest in hospitalised children
audits.f: Staff trained in paediatric sleep 4%; multi-faceted sleep promotion 21%; relaxation techniques 0%.
audits.c: Evidence-based strategies including staff training on paediatric sleep.
audits.r2: Staff trained 80%; multi-faceted sleep promotion 87%; relaxation techniques 80%.

audits.t: Patient safety during transfers from critical care: developing and assessing a checklist.
audits.st: Intensive Care Society transfer guidance
audits.f: not reported
audits.c: Patient transfer checklist developed from Intensive Care Society guidance
audits.r2: Evaluated by incident reports, staff compliance audit and user survey (figures not given in abstract)

audits.t: Transfusion sample mislabelling and wrong blood in tube in the UK: Insights from the national comparative audits of blood transfusion in 2012 and 2022.
audits.tp: Transfusion sample labelling and wrong blood in tube
audits.st: Correct transfusion sample labelling; sample rejection and wrong blood in tube rates compared with 2012 audit
audits.f: Rejection rate 2.99%; WBIT 1 in 8547 samples
audits.c: No specific intervention; between audits more sites introduced bedside electronic labelling (23% of sites, up 224%)
audits.r2: 23,584 rejected samples from 179 sites; rejection rate 4.4% (47% increase); 92 WBIT incidents, 1 in 5882 (45% increase)

audits.t: Discharge Perfection: Assessing Documentation Quality at Mardan Medical Complex, Pakistan (2024 Audit Debut).
audits.st: Royal College of Physicians, Islamabad Healthcare Regulatory Authority and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Care Commission discharge standards
audits.f: Contact details and safety alerts absent in 100%; father's name missing 48%; clinical summary absent 73%; procedural details absent 87%; follow-up recommended in 71%; medication dose missing 61%, route 28%, duration 20%.

audits.t: Clinical Audit for Integration of Communicable and Non-Communicable Diseases at the Primary Health Care Level in Tanzania.
audits.tp: Integration of communicable and non-communicable disease care
audits.st: Clinical standards for infection prevention, TB diagnosis, advanced HIV, chronic lung disease and bidirectional TB-diabetes screening
audits.f: Infection prevention mean score 42/114 (37%); 3/80 (4%) with productive cough evaluated for TB; 6/24 (25%) advanced HIV had TB test; 12/102 (12%) TB patients screened for diabetes.

audits.t: A clinical audit of red blood cell transfusion practices at a district hospital in South Africa.
audits.st: South African transfusion guidelines
audits.f: Guidelines applied appropriately in 68.4% (52/76); pre-transfusion haemoglobin documented for all (median 4.6 g/dL).

audits.t: Improving eye care in an intensive care unit.
audits.st: National eye exposure (eye care) guidelines
audits.f: 2% adherence to eye exposure guidelines
audits.c: Eye care protocol integrated into the electronic patient record plus poster summary of guidelines (PDSA)

audits.t: Lumbar medial branch block progression to radiofrequency neurotomy: A retrospective audit of clinical practice.
audits.tp: Lumbar medial branch block selection for radiofrequency neurotomy
audits.st: Dual diagnostic lumbar medial branch blocks with ≥80% pain relief threshold (Medicare LCD)
audits.f: 90/167 (54%) progressed from MBB1 to MBB2; 66/90 (73%) progressed from MBB2 to RFN. With laxer criteria, 124/167 (74%) and 99/124 (80%).

audits.t: Pressure ulcers: a clinical audit to determine compliance against the aSSKINg framework in an adult community nursing setting.
audits.st: aSSKINg pressure ulcer prevention framework
audits.f: Overall compliance poor; only two criteria met: chair equipment provision and referral to tissue viability

audits.t: Reducing maternal infection after assisted vaginal birth in a diverse and deprived population.
audits.tp: Antibiotic prophylaxis after assisted vaginal birth
audits.st: National recommendation for a single dose of prophylactic antibiotics after assisted vaginal birth
audits.f: Prophylactic antibiotic administration 13.2%.
audits.c: Evidence-based journal clubs for doctors in training, presentations of results after each audit cycle, and expedited change of local guidelines.
audits.r2: Prophylactic antibiotic administration 90.7%; over 90% in both labour ward rooms and theatre.

audits.t: Improving the Accuracy of the Gynaecology Handover Process: An Effective Quality Improvement Project at a University Hospital in the United Kingdom.
audits.st: Handover quality proforma: team presence, SBAR format, theatre list updates, pending referrals, sick patients and new admissions
audits.f: Baseline handover performance recorded on the proforma (figures not given in abstract).
audits.c: New separate gynaecology handover with consultants, registrars, SHOs and nurses; daily quality review using a proforma with monthly review and practical solutions.
audits.r2: Statistically significant improvement in seven of eleven parameters (McNemar test).

audits.t: Introduction of a section for recording dementia improves data capture on the ambulance electronic patient record: evidence from a regional quality improvement project.
audits.st: Recording of dementia on ambulance ePRs for patients aged 65 or over (no target stated)
audits.f: Dementia recorded in 13.5% of patients aged 65 or over and 16.5% of those aged 75 or over.
audits.c: A dedicated dementia section (tab) with a diagnosis button and free-text field added to the ePR.
audits.r2: Dementia recorded in 16.5% (n = 18,515) aged 65 or over and 19.9% aged 75 or over; 69.9% of these used the dementia button and 25.4% the tab free text.

audits.t: Intervention time and adverse events in a canadian epilepsy monitoring unit: An updated audit.
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: Intervention rate 27.8%; intervention time 21.0 s; adverse event rate 1.2%
audits.c: Move to a new single-floor EMU supervised by EEG technologists by day and beneficiary attendants at night and weekends
audits.r2: Intervention rate 61.1%; median intervention time 29.0 s (19.0-45.9 s); adverse event rate 4.8% across 537 seizures

audits.t: Assessment of the quality of oral squamous cell carcinoma clinical records in oral surgery with Surgical Tool for Auditing Records (STAR) scoring.
audits.st: Surgical Tool for Auditing Records (STAR) scoring (50 points)
audits.f: All 50 records scored 49/50; deductions in operative record for missing suture information.

audits.t: Proteinuria Assessment and Therapeutic Implementation in Chronic Kidney Disease Patients-A Clinical Audit on KDIGO ("Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes") Guidelines.
audits.tp: CKD detection and management in primary care
audits.st: KDIGO guidelines for proteinuria assessment and treatment
audits.f: Proteinuria assessed in 120 (28.1%) patients; corresponding treatment prescribed in 59%.

audits.t: The impact of clinical audit on antibiotic prescribing in dental practice at Taibah University Dental Hospital.
audits.st: Guidelines on appropriate antibiotic prescribing in dental practice
audits.f: 119 antibiotic prescriptions; inappropriate prescribing prevalent.
audits.c: Action plan with guidelines and educational sessions.

audits.t: Gastrostomy management by the nursing team in a hospital in São Paulo, Brazil: a best practice implementation project.
audits.st: JBI best practice criteria for gastrostomy management (eight criteria)
audits.f: Baseline audit of 33 nurses, 90 nursing technicians and 10 gastrostomy patients against eight criteria; baseline compliance figures not reported in abstract.
audits.c: Audit feedback used to identify barriers and design implementation strategies (details not reported).
audits.r2: Follow-up audit of 37 nurses, 80 nursing technicians and 10 patients: compliance reached 90% for three of eight criteria; remaining criteria 20% to 50%. Improvement in five of eight criteria.

audits.t: Implementation of a heart failure disease management program in the rural southern United States: a best practice implementation project.
audits.st: JBI best practice for heart failure management (enrolment in disease management programme)
audits.f: 0% compliance with best practice.
audits.c: Policy/protocol for a disease management programme and a virtual multidisciplinary team.

audits.t: Assessing and Enhancing the Adequacy of Radiology Request Forms at a Tertiary Care Hospital in Sudan: A Clinical Audit.
audits.st: Royal College of Radiologists (RCR) standards for radiology request forms
audits.f: Mean documentation score 25.33%; patient address, phone number and location recorded in 0 (0%); age in 15 (30%).
audits.c: Blank paper request format replaced by a structured RCR-based form, distributed hospital-wide, with presentations and briefings for doctors.
audits.r2: Mean documentation score 97.77%; address, phone number and location 50 (100%); age 50 (100%).

audits.t: Prevention and management of allergic-like reactions to iodine contrast media: a best practice implementation project.
audits.tp: Contrast media reaction prevention and management
audits.st: Four JBI best practice audit criteria for prevention and management of allergic-like reactions to iodine contrast media
audits.f: Emergency equipment management 37.50%; overall reaction rate 0.56%.
audits.c: Strategies designed from audit feedback to address identified barriers.
audits.r2: More than 60% compliance with the four criteria; emergency equipment management 100%; reaction rate 0.19%.

audits.t: An audit of pre-operative dental radiographs in patients who received no pre-operative dental input before cardiovalvular surgery.
audits.tp: Dental assessment before cardiac valve surgery
audits.st: not reported
audits.f: 87.5% of OPTs were Quality Standard 2; 79% had advanced periodontal bone loss; mean DMFT 16.4

audits.t: A Clinical Audit of Pregnancy Testing in Females Presenting With Abdominal Pain to the General Surgery Department of a District General Hospital.
audits.tp: Pregnancy testing in acute abdominal pain
audits.st: All female patients of childbearing age (11-55 years) with acute abdominal pain should have a urinary or serum beta-HCG pregnancy test
audits.f: Pregnancy testing completed in 41.8% (n=23).
audits.c: Medical education session, posters and multidisciplinary discussion in a nursing huddle.

audits.t: Improving the Monitoring and Management of Clozapine-Induced Gastrointestinal Hypomotility (CIGH) in Community Mental Health Services: A Quality Improvement Approach.
audits.st: Prevention, detection and management of clozapine-induced gastrointestinal hypomotility, with clinical documentation
